TetraFiVersion.description: The dated API version to answer this request in. Without it, an API key's requests use the version the key pinned when it was created, and a member session uses the current version. A value that is not exactly one supported date answers 400 API_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED before anything runs. The response's TetraFi-Version header names the version used.
TetraFiVersion.name: TetraFi-Version

WorkspaceId.description: The workspace the request acts in, for an operation whose path does not name one. Every API key is bound to exactly one workspace and implies it, so an API-key caller never needs this header; if sent, it must be that same id (another id answers 403 WORKSPACE_SCOPE_MISMATCH). A member session must send it (400 WORKSPACE_REQUIRED without it).
WorkspaceId.name: X-Workspace-Id

ApiError.description:
The shared refusal body of every integrator operation, including edge-layer errors.
`error` is an open, stable machine-readable code; `docUrl` links to its documentation and
`retryable` says whether an unchanged request may succeed later. `message` is for people,
not matching. `timestamp` is RFC 3339 UTC; optional `requestId` mirrors `X-Request-Id`.
Optional `next` describes recovery and `details` carries code-specific information.
Handle known codes and fall back on the HTTP status for unknown ones.

oneOf.description: Extra information specific to `error`, omitted when none is supplied.

details.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

docUrl.description: Stable documentation for this refusal code.

message.description: What happened, in words a person can read. Not for matching.

oneOf.description: The way forward, when there is one (for example `requote` on an expired quote).

next.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

requestId.description:
The request's id, the value the `X-Request-Id` response header carries. Quote it when
asking for support.

retryable.description: Whether an unchanged request may succeed later, from the error catalogue.

timestamp.description: When the refusal was made, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.

additionalProperties.description:
Any further detail the code carries (for example `stepUpSubject`, `balanceShortfall`,
`minimumAmount`), each named in camelCase.

ApiErrorDetails.description:
The code's detail. Keys are per code and may grow: each field is present only on the codes
named beside it, and any code may carry further fields, named in camelCase, which a client
must tolerate and may ignore.

capabilityBlockers.description: `CAPABILITY_BLOCKED` and the other capability refusals: what blocks the workspace.

cause.description:
The named cause behind the code. `VENUE_QUOTE_NOT_PRICED`: the venue's own quote outcome,
one of the `sources[].status` tokens of `POST /quotes` (for example `refused`,
`timedOut`, `firmQuoteLimited`, `unavailable`), or `notListed` when the venue gave no
outcome at all. `PRICE_ACCOUNT_NOT_PRICED`: `connectionNotFound` (the venue connection the
price was read on is no longer this workspace's) or `otherAccountPriced` (the venue priced
only another of this workspace's accounts). An open set: treat an unknown value as other.

conflicts.description: `REQUOTE_FIELDS_CONFLICT`: the fields that cannot go with `requote`.

oneOf.description:
`SETTLEMENT_WINDOW_CHANGED`: the settlement window the order consented to (the quoted
window, or the one its `settlementWindowId` named), which is no longer the one assigned.

currentReceive.description:
`VENUE_QUOTE_OUTSIDE_BOUNDS`: what the venue's price delivers now, as an exact decimal in

oneOf.description:
`SETTLEMENT_WINDOW_CHANGED`: the settlement window the server assigns the trade now.
Send the same quote again with `settlementWindowId` set to `details.currentWindow.windowId`
to consent to it.

remediation.description:
A machine-readable recovery hint the refusing step gave: an open set of camelCase tokens.
A venue order refusal names its remedy with the order outcome's tokens (retry, widenLimit,
requote, chooseAnotherLp, contactSupport) and, when known, states requiredSlippageBps (the
tolerance below the quoted receive amount the order needs), currentReceive (what the
venue's price delivers), and quoteId with expiresAt (a fresh quote to place) beside it.

remedy.description:
What to do next, in words: the error catalogue's remedy for this response's error code,
present on every catalogued integrator refusal. For people and logs, not for matching:
match on the error code and on remediation instead.

requiredSlippageBps.description:
`VENUE_QUOTE_OUTSIDE_BOUNDS`: the tolerance below the quoted receive amount, in basis
points rounded up, that an order needs at the venue's price. Absent when unknown, and when
the venue's price is at or above the quoted receive amount: the order's own limit was above
the price, so lower it to at most `currentReceive`.

oneOf.description:
Every `429`, and a `503` that knows: when to try again, as an ISO 8601 duration. The
`Retry-After` header carries the same wait in whole seconds.

value.description:
`ASSET_UNKNOWN`, `NETWORK_UNKNOWN`, `VENUE_UNKNOWN`, `AMOUNT_INVALID`: the value refused;
`ASSET_NOT_ON_NETWORK`: the pinned chain the Asset is not on.

venueId.description:
The venue the refusal is about, as the order's `venueId` names it. Present when the
refusing step names one. Not the venue's own refusal code, which is `venueCode`.

Status of a KYB review: pending, under_review, approved, rejected or expired.

ArrivalFinality.description:
Whether the arrival finality behind a window's answer clocks was read. `read`: every retained
arrival's finality was read and the account's movement observation is current. `unreadable`:
an arrival's finality, or the account's movement observation, could not be read (`code` names
it). An unreadable finality never starts or stops a clock, and no lateness, overdue, carry or
fee is assessed against a deadline it leaves unknown. A window with no arrivals reads `read`.
Clients must tolerate values added later.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ArrivalFinalityRead.description: Every arrival behind the clocks was read; none at all is a read value too.

status.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ArrivalFinalityUnreadable.description: The named read failed; clocks already started from final arrivals stay started.

code.description: Machine-readable reason arrival finality could not be established.

AssetsResponse.description:
Assets available to the current workspace. An eligibility input the listing could not read
(the onboarded venues, the on-chain markets or the Keyrock catalogue) leaves its Assets out and
is named in `unreachable`, so a shorter list is never read as complete.

oneOf.description:
What would widen the listing: `NO_COUNTERPARTY_CONNECTED` when no venue the workspace
has enabled lists an asset (connect one in Venues), `COUNTERPARTY_NOT_READY` when nothing
is listed because each connected venue is still being set up, paused, or needs Advanced
while it is not available, `MORE_COUNTERPARTIES_AVAILABLE` when other venues are
available to connect. Absent when every venue is enabled, or when the enabled venues could
not all be read (see `unreachable`).

items.description: Assets available through eligible venues, limited to the current page when pagination is requested.

On a paged request (`limit` or `cursor`), the cursor of the next page;

unreachable.description:
Empty when every eligibility input was read. Otherwise source `venueEligibility` (its code,
`ONBOARDED_VENUES_UNAVAILABLE` or `ONCHAIN_MARKETS_UNAVAILABLE`, in `details.ownerCode`), and
one entry per pair source not read, named as `GET /pairs` names them: `venueMarkets` with the
venue in `id`, or `venueConnections`, `assetCatalogue`, `advancedConnections`,
`advancedRoutes`. `reason` is an open set: `notReadYet` (a venue's first market read is in
flight: read again in a few seconds) or `unavailable` (the read failed: retry later).

protocol fee and settle in seconds; standard modes wait for hard
finality. Forwarding fees apply independently to both.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

Caip2Chain.description:
A CAIP-2 chain id (`eip155:8453`, `solana:<genesis>`, `tron:shasta`), syntax-checked:
a namespace of 3 to 8 lowercase letters, digits or `-`, and a reference of 1 to 32
letters, digits, `-` or `_`. Compared exactly, as CAIP-2 references are case-sensitive.

CalendarStatus.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

CandidateBalance.description:
A candidate's balance of the pay Asset, tagged `kind`. A cold or
failed read is `unavailable`, never 0. `variant` names the token the
balance was read in (an Octarine route pays mUSDC, a variant of the requested USDC).

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

variant.description: The pay deployment's variant whose token balance this is.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

reason.description: A camelCase token naming why (`notWarmed`).

amount.description: Exact asset quantity, never a floating-point value.

asset.description: Asset moved into or out of the account.

blockHash.description: Hash of the observed block, or `null` without block evidence.

confirmations.description: Observed network confirmations, or `null` when unavailable or not applicable.

correlationState.description: Whether the observed movement is matched, pending a match, or ambiguous.

destinationFinancialAccountId.description: Identifier of the receiving financial account, or `null` when unresolved.

direction.description: Whether funds move into or out of the venue account.

evidence.description: Observations, matching and finality criteria, and recorded reviews underlying the movement.

finalityState.description: Current finality assessment, including failed, reversed, or reorganized transfers.

lastSuccessfulReadAt.description: Latest successful source or network verification time for this movement.

lpTransferId.description: Transfer identifier reported by the liquidity provider, or `null` without a provider observation.

network.description: Network of the transfer, or `null` when no network is known or applicable.

observedAt.description: Latest observation time among the records combined into this movement.

occurredAt.description: When the transfer occurred according to the primary observation.

requiredConfirmations.description: Network confirmations required by the finality policy, or `null` when unavailable or not applicable.

revision.description: Revision of this movement's recorded facts.

sourceFinancialAccountId.description: Identifier of the sending financial account, or `null` when unresolved.

transferIndex.description: Index identifying this transfer within the transaction, or `null` when not known.

txHash.description: On-chain transaction hash, or `null` when no transaction hash is recorded.

venueAccountId.description: Identifier of the venue account the movement enters or leaves.

walletTransferId.description: Transfer identifier from the wallet observation, or `null` without a wallet observation.

CapabilityBlocker.description: One reason a capability is blocked, plus the step that unlocks it.

code.description: Machine-readable cause of the capability refusal.

currentlyDue.description:
Requirement keys still due, such as `kyb_review`, `actor_kyc` or
`permission:place_order`. Empty when nothing specific is due.

estimate.description: Expected resolution category for the suggested next step, not a deadline.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of what is blocking this capability.

unlockStep.description:
Stable key of the step that unlocks this blocker. The UI maps it to a
route or dialog.

CapabilityBlockerCode.description:
Stable machine-readable blocker codes returned by the capability gate.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

allowed.description: Whether this capability is currently available to the caller in this workspace.

blockers.description: Reasons the capability is blocked, omitted when no blockers are reported.

CapabilityFreshness.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

CapabilityState.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

CapabilityUnlockEstimate.description:
Coarse time-to-unlock class. The UI owns the copy; figures are engineering
estimates until the KYB queue and Sumsub webhooks supply measured values.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

CapabilityUnlockStep.description:
Stable key for the step that unlocks a blocked capability. The backend
names the step; the UI owns the step-to-route map. Never a UI route.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

CardFirmness.description:
How firm a card's price is: `quality: firm` delivers exactly `buy.amount` until `expiresAt`;
`quality: executable` executes held to `minOut`, until `expiresAt` when it states one, or, for a
desk's live price (`basis: liveQuote`, `expiresAt` null), until `staleAfter`, after which its
order is still taken within the caller's minimum receive for a short window at a fresh venue
price; `quality: indicative` (`expiresAt` null) lapses at `staleAfter` and is orderable only
through its `next: order`, executed within the caller's minimum receive.

quality.description:
The price guarantee: firm (the venue is bound to `buy.amount` until `expiresAt`, and no
venue re-checks an accepted price before it fills), executable with a minimum, or
indicative only.

CarryFeeApplication.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

application.description: Whether the fee is a separate obligation or already included in the provider's figures.

obligationId.description: Identifier of the separate fee obligation, omitted when the fee is already in the provider's figures.

version.description: Version of the recorded carry-fee assessment.

CatalogueVenueKind.description:
A Venue's kind: where its money sits. Each Venue declares its kind in the
venue-desk catalogue (`catalogue::Venue.kind`), which re-exports this type.
Published as `CatalogueVenueKind`: the `VenueKind` component is the solver
classifier (`solvers::VenueKind`, solver-operated or direct venue).

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

forwardTransaction.description: Spoke DDR v2 RoutedDepositForwarded transaction, never the CCIP dispatch.

venueDepositId.description: Hexadecimal venue deposit identifier recorded in the on-chain confirmation.

venueTxHash.description: Venue evidence only; never a chain explorer reference.

accountAssetKey.description: Hexadecimal key identifying the credited account and asset on the settlement ledger.

amount.description: Deposit amount in the deposited asset's base units, as a decimal integer string.

applicationTransaction.description: On-chain transaction that first recorded the deposit on the settlement ledger.

confirmation.description: On-chain confirmation of the venue deposit, omitted until recorded.

depositKey.description: Hexadecimal identifier of this deposit on the settlement ledger.

ledger.description: Hexadecimal address of the settlement ledger contract.

CexLaneSettlement.description:
Confirmed CEX ledger stages as public reads serve them: each transaction names its chain by
`network` (or `networkUnsupported`).

deposits.description: Deposits recorded on the settlement ledger for this order.

tradeFills.description: Venue fills recorded on the settlement ledger for this order.

actualInputAmount.description: Actual amount spent in the input asset's base units, as a decimal integer string.

actualOutputAmount.description: Actual amount received in the output asset's base units, as a decimal integer string.

evidenceHash.description: Hexadecimal hash of the evidence supporting the fill.

ledger.description: Hexadecimal address of the settlement ledger contract.

transaction.description: On-chain transaction that recorded the venue fill on the settlement ledger.

venueFillId.description: Hexadecimal venue fill identifier recorded on the settlement ledger.

ChainFamily.description:
The family of wallets and addresses a chain uses. Matches `WalletFamily`;
`bitcoin` is named but no chain parser yields it yet (no Bitcoin network is
modelled), and every consumer refuses it as unsupported, never as EVM.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ClientFirstStep.description:
The order's first step, signed from the quote's `signing.firstStep` and sent with the
order, with the quote's `stepId`: a signed transaction for TetraFi to relay, or a signature,
each in its network's own encoding. A transaction the client broadcast itself (`transactionHash`) and `declined` are
answers on the step route only: nothing is broadcast before the wallet's screening passed,
and an order the client would decline is simply not placed.

ClientFirstStepSignature.description:
`signature`: the signature over the first step's message in the network's encoding
(EVM `typedData`: the `0x` hex of the 65-byte signature).

ClientFirstStepSignedTransaction.description:
`raw`: the signed transaction for TetraFi to relay, in the network's native encoding
(EVM: the `0x` hex of an EIP-2718 envelope).

ClientSigningStep.description:
One step a client signs with its own wallet: what TetraFi prepared, for the client to sign
and hand back. TetraFi never holds the wallet's key; it checks the signed answer against
this step before it relays it. The quote's `signing.firstStep` and the order's `next.step`
are this one shape. `type` names what is signed and selects the variant; every variant
carries `stepId`, `sequence`, `purpose`, `network`, `from`, `signBy`, `signer` and `legId`.
New types arrive as new variants (another network family's transaction or message, a
batch): a client stops on a `type` it does not know.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ClientSigningStepTransaction.description:
A `transaction` step (EVM): sign `transaction` with the wallet's key on the EIP-155 chain id
of `network`, and hand back the signed transaction or broadcast it.

covers.description: Every leg this one signature authorises, by `legId`. Absent: only this step's `legId`.

legId.description: The leg this step belongs to.

network.description:
CAIP-2 network of the wallet and the transaction (`eip155:11155111`); its EIP-155
chain id is the one to sign with.

sequence.description: 1-based order of the step within its trade.

signBy.description: When the step lapses: nothing signed for it is relayed or accepted afterwards.

allOf.description: An EVM transaction to sign and send.

type.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ClientSigningStepTransactionVariant.description: An EVM transaction to sign and send.

ClientSigningStepTypedData.description:
A `typedData` step (EVM): sign `typedData` with the wallet's key as EIP-712 and hand back
the signature.

covers.description: Every leg this one signature authorises, by `legId`. Absent: only this step's `legId`.

legId.description: The leg this step belongs to.

network.description:
CAIP-2 network of the wallet (`eip155:11155111`); the typed data's domain names its
chain id.

sequence.description: 1-based order of the step within its trade.

signBy.description: When the step lapses: nothing signed for it is relayed or accepted afterwards.

typedData.description: EIP-712 typed data (`domain`, `types`, `primaryType`, `message`), exactly as signed.

allOf.description: EVM EIP-712 typed data to sign.

type.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ClientSigningStepTypedDataVariant.description: EVM EIP-712 typed data to sign.

ClientSigningTransaction.description:
The EVM transaction of a `transaction` step. Sign it unchanged with the pinned `nonce`; fees
are the signer's choice. Steps on other networks arrive as their own step types.

nonce.description:
The wallet's nonce the transaction must use. A transaction with another nonce is
refused, and so is this step once another transaction used this nonce.

value.description: Wei, as an exact decimal string.

ClientStepPurpose.description:
What a step does, for display. An open list: a client ignores a value it does not know.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ClientStepSubmission.description:
How the client answers a step: the step's signed transaction for TetraFi to relay, the
transaction it broadcast itself, a signature, or a refusal to sign. Each kind carries the
network's own encoding of its value; new kinds may be added for other network families.

ClientStepSubmissionDeclined.description:
The client will not sign this step. Ends the order `unfilled` / `not_sent` when
nothing was sent. Step route only.

ClientStepSubmissionSignature.description:
`signature`: the signature over the step's message in the network's encoding (EVM
`typedData`: the `0x` hex of the 65-byte signature).

ClientStepSubmissionSignedTransaction.description:
`raw`: the signed transaction in the network's native encoding (EVM: the `0x` hex of an
EIP-2718 envelope). TetraFi decodes it, checks it against the step and broadcasts it.

ClientStepSubmissionTransactionHash.description:
`txHash`: the network's identifier of the step's transaction the client broadcast
itself (EVM: its `0x` transaction hash). TetraFi reads it from the chain and applies the
same checks.

ClientStepType.description:
What the client signs for a step: an order step's `type`, and the `type` that selects a
client step's variant. An open list: a client stops on a type it does not know.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

fees.description:
Fee breakdown: gas, protocol fee, solver fee, relayer tips. Absent
when the order predates fee capture.

legs.description:
Uniform per-leg execution model for multi-leg route orders; absent for
single-leg escrow / deferred orders. Mirrors `OrderResponse.legs`.

orderKind.description: Canonical route-aware order kind. Mirrors the orderKind field of OrderResponse.

substatus.description: Finer-grained state within the coarse status (route `routeStatus`, etc.).

substatusMessage.description:
Human-readable elaboration of `substatus` — a Circle StableFX status line, or
the reason a parked/refunded/recovered order is in that state. Mirrors
`OrderResponse.substatusMessage`.

CompanyTradeDetail.description: Full trade detail with Sections A-E.

actionRequired.description:
Set when the order is waiting on a person rather than on a chain or a solver:
a composite parked until its taker re-quotes and signs the next leg. Its coarse
`status` still reads `executing`, identical to a leg in flight, so this is the
only list field that tells the two apart. Absent for every other order.

apiKey.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

channel.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

custodyVaultAddress.description:
Custody vault address when the order settled through a custody vault.
Absent for self-custody orders.

deliveredBuyProvenance.description:
Provenance of the delivered buy amount behind `slippage_bps`: `"measured"`
vs `"quoted"` (carried forward unmeasured). See the detail section.

executionPrice.description:
The order's price, labelled by `source`: `storedQuotePrice` is the quote it was placed
on, also on an order that never filled (read `settlementFacts` and `status` before
showing it as executed); `derivedFromAmounts` is what was delivered.

failureReason.description:
Why the order failed or was refunded, as the detail's `settlement.failureReason`
reports it: absent while the order has no recorded failure.

linkedWalletId.description:
Account-linked wallet id that placed the trade, for per-wallet filtering
and display. Absent for router-executed or unattributed orders that carry
no linked wallet.

lpName.description: Legacy LP label; use venueName and executionMethod for venue display.

lpVenueId.description:
The catalogue Venue id of the order's LP (a routed order's first leg), so a
client draws the LP's logo by identity rather than its display label.
Absent when no catalogue Venue declares that LP.

makerAttribution.description: The order's recorded maker, absent if no execution type was recorded.

nextAction.description:
The typed form of `actionRequired`: the same decision the order page reads
(`OrderResponse.nextAction`), computed by the same backend owner. Clients switch on
its `kind`; `actionRequired` stays for older clients and is derived from it.

nextActor.description: Who acts next: the same decision the order read carries.

orderKind.description:
Canonical route-aware order kind, matching the detail read for both members and
API-key callers. Absent for non-route orders, where the order type suffices.

pair.description: The market pair of `executionPrice` (`BASE/QUOTE`), absent when either symbol is unknown.

settlementFacts.description: Where the order's settlement stands, the same block every trade row carries.

settlementSpeedSeconds.description: Settlement duration in seconds (millisecond precision), when recorded.

settlementStatus.description: Where the order's recorded settlement stands.

status.description: The order's status, the same value its order read answers.

submittedByYou.description:
The caller submitted this order: the same rule as the order read's
`viewer.submittedByYou` (the linked wallet's user or the order's user is the caller).
Always false for an API-key caller.

valueUsd.description:
USD value of the trade (its input notional), as a decimal string. Absent when the order
recorded no USD notional; never 0 for an unknown amount.

CompanyTradeListItem.description: A single trade in the paginated list view.

CompanyVenueTradeListItem.description: A venue trade in the one trade history.

apiKey.description: Attribution of the API key that placed the trade, when available.

buy.description: What the trade buys: its asset and, when recorded, the least it must receive from its consented bounds.

connectionId.description: Identifier of the venue connection used for this trade.

createdAt.description: When the venue trade operation was created.

debitExpirySignature.description:
For an expired debit proof, whether wallet records contain a typed signature:
`recorded` or `unconfirmed`. Absent when the retained steps cannot establish either.

executionMethod.description: Human execution-method label, or `Unknown method` for unresolved history.

executionPrice.description:
Legacy confirmed output per input (buy asset / sell asset), computed with Decimal;
null when unread. executionPriceUnit states its unit; prefer statedExecutionPrice for display.

executionPriceUnit.description: Asset units of `executionPrice`, omitted when that price is unavailable.

executionStatus.description: Current execution outcome or progress at the venue, separate from settlement.

executionTypeId.description: The execution type (compiled spec id), not the catalogue Venue.

feesPaid.description:
What a confirmed same-asset fill (a bridge) cost the taker: spent minus
received, the venue's protocol and forwarding fees, in the sell asset. Absent unless confirmed and positive.

financials.description: The trade's recorded money terms and payment legs, from the same records as the order read; history never re-derives a fee or minimum.

inputSpent.description: What the venue debited and credited, once its outcome is recorded.

lifecycleStatus.description: The same lifecycle shape an order row carries; `needsReview` is not final.

notSentCause.description:
The stable code behind `notSentReason`, the same value the venue-trade detail's
`notSentCause` carries (for example `WALLET_NONCE_PENDING`). A code this version does not
know is still named. Absent when no cause was retained.

notSentReason.description: Why a `not_sent` outcome was not sent, as the dispatch's `notSentReason`.

operationId.description: Identifier of the venue trade operation.

outcomeCode.description:
Why the trade ended as it did, as its dispatch records it (the order page's
`dispatch.outcomeCode`): the history row names a no-fill's reason from it.
Absent until an outcome is recorded.

outputReceived.description: Amount credited by the confirmed fill, as a decimal string in `buy.asset` units; omitted when unconfirmed.

pair.description: The recorded market pair; absent stays absent, never inferred from asset order.

placedBy.description: Who placed the trade: the API key by label, else the member where this reader may see their name. Absent otherwise.

providerSite.description: Exact provider site selected for this venue trade.

sell.description: What the trade sells: its asset and, when recorded, the most it may spend from its consented bounds.

settlement.description:
How and when the trade settles, as recorded before it was sent: the same block the order
read returns as `settlement` (method, timing and, for a delayed trade, its window with
`settlesBy` and `paymentDeadlineAt`). Absent on a trade recorded without it.

settlementCarriedInto.description:
The later window the trade's amounts were netted into, as the order read's
`settlementCarriedInto`. Absent when nothing was netted.

settlementFacts.description:
Where the trade's settlement stands, the same block every trade row carries; a
prefunded fill states `settledAtFill`.

settlementStatement.description:
Whether the statement of the window the trade settles in is out, as the order read's
`settlementStatement`. Absent with `settlementStatus` and without a window.

settlementStatus.description:
Where the filled trade's settlement stands; the same value as the order read's
`settlementStatus`. Absent before the fill and without recorded terms.

settlementUntrackedReason.description:
Why the filled trade's settlement is not tracked, as the order read's
`settlementUntrackedReason`; `settlementFacts.status` then reads `unrecorded`. Absent on
every other trade. An open set.

statedExecutionPrice.description: QuoteCurrencyPriority market convention, with explicit base/quote and fallback basis.

submittedByYou.description: Whether the caller is the member who initiated this operation.

tetrafiFee.description:
Gross TetraFi fee (list rate, before incentives) from the Basic billing ledger, with its
asset; absent until accrued.

transferMode.description:
CCTP's selected finality tier, as the order read's `operation.onChain.transferMode`: the
bound selection, never re-derived. A CCTP trade without it is Standard (historical and
omitted selections); absent on every other venue.

uncertainCode.description:
The dispatch's first unknown-outcome failure: a closed code, never a provider body.
A later terminal outcome takes precedence over this retained diagnostic.

valueUsd.description:
A reference USD value of what the trade sells, by the same price service that values an
order row's `valueUsd`, at the price when read. `valueUsdBasis` says which amount it
values. Absent when the asset has no reference price or the price read failed; never 0
for an unknown value.

valueUsdBasis.description:
`executed` (what the venue debited, on a fill) or `requested` (the most the trade
could spend, otherwise). Present exactly when `valueUsd` is.

venueAccountName.description:
The workspace's venue account it went through, titled by its catalogue Venue
("Keyrock account"), never by the execution type ("Keyrock OTC"); an on-chain venue is
never an account and reads as itself ("Circle StableFX").

venueId.description: Catalogue venue id; null when the recorded execution type cannot be resolved.

venueName.description: The catalogue venue's display name, or `Unknown venue` for unresolved history.

current.description: False once a newer statement version replaced the one it acknowledged.

note.description: Reviewer's note, required when the figures differ and otherwise nullable.

recordedBy.description: Identifier of the member who recorded the comparison.

result.description: Whether the reviewer recorded the two sets of figures as matching or differing.

statementVersion.description: Version of the platform statement reviewed against the liquidity provider's figures.

ComparisonResult.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ConnectableVenue.description: A venue that would serve a pair once the workspace acts, and what it must do.

venueId.description: The venue entry (`b2c2-rfq`).

ConnectableVenueStatus.description:
Why a venue's pair is listed under `availability=connectable` instead of tradable now. Treat a
value you do not know as "not tradable yet".

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ConsequencePolicy.description:
The LP's explicit, versioned consequence terms. Every setting is stated;
an absent policy is unavailable, never read as all disabled.

grace.description: Whether the recorded terms provide a grace period.

lateFee.description: Whether the recorded terms provide a late fee.

rollover.description: Whether unpaid amounts carry forward at the payment deadline instead of becoming overdue.

source.description: Reference for the liquidity provider's consequence terms.

tradingBlock.description: Whether the recorded terms provide for blocking trading after late payment.

version.description: Version of the recorded consequence terms.

ConsequenceSetting.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ContinuationRepricingOffer.description:
The fresh price a continuation was refused at, left for the taker to accept once.

Carried by the 409 `QUOTE_PRICE_MOVED` body. It binds one attempt of one leg and
expires; accepting it rebaselines only that attempt.

acceptedAmount.description:
The reference the order held the leg to (the price accepted at quote time, or a
re-price accepted earlier in this attempt), in base units.

asset.description: The compared asset, when the order records it.

attempt.description: The attempt this offer belongs to, numbered as in the order's `legAttempts`.

boundAmount.description: The bound the fresh value had to meet: `acceptedAmount` widened by the tolerance.

compared.description: Whether the accepted and fresh amounts compare the leg's input or its output.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC time after which the offer can no longer be accepted.

freshAmount.description: The fresh value the venue quoted, in base units.

legId.description:
The leg being repriced, as the order names it in `legs[].legId`: the id its quote
published, or `unrecorded-leg-<position>` for a retained leg that kept no id.

quoteRef.description: Identifies this offer. Accepting it must name this value.

CorrelationState.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

CounterpartyHint.description: What would widen a short answer.

code.description:
`NO_COUNTERPARTY_CONNECTED` (the workspace has no venue that lists anything: connect one),
`MORE_COUNTERPARTIES_AVAILABLE` (connecting more venues can add assets and prices) or
`COUNTERPARTY_NOT_READY` (the connected venues list nothing until their setup is finished
or trading on them is resumed). An open set: new codes may be added, so treat an unknown
one as information.

message.description: The same advice in plain words, for a person.

CounterpartyState.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

cause.description: Explanation of the coverage gap or qualification affecting the trade.

dispatchId.description: Identifier of the trade operation affected by this coverage issue.

CreateWalletRequest.description: An organisation wallet to create (scope organisation): the wallet connection, family, networks and name, the owner group that approves it, and optionally the registered URL the approval page returns each person to.

connectionId.description: A workspace wallet connection id, or `platform-<provider>` for TetraFi's platform account.

displayName.description: Name to display for the new wallet.

family.description: Network family the new wallet must support.

networks.description: The networks of the family switched on at creation (CAIP-2). Others can be switched on later.

ownerGroup.description: People and approval threshold that will control the new wallet.

returnUrl.description:
Where TetraFi's approval page sends each person of an organisation wallet
back once the signing page has recorded their part: an `https` URL (plain
`http` only on localhost) whose exact origin (scheme, host and port) is one
of the workspace's registered embedded-wallet callback origins. The person
returns to it with `signingRequestId` and `outcome` added to its query:
`approved` (their part is recorded), `pending` (recorded, the wallet waits
for others) or `refused` (the signing page refused to finish; the person is
shown why first and goes back only when they choose). Any other URL, and one
on TetraFi's own app or signing origin, is refused with 400
`RETURN_URL_NOT_REGISTERED`.

scope.description: Whether the new wallet belongs to the caller personally or to the organisation.

visibility.description:
An organisation wallet's visibility to the workspace, as the organisation
setup form states it; `readable` when absent. Refused for a personal wallet.

CreateWebhookDeliveryRequest.description: Create a test delivery under an existing webhook.

kind.description: Only test deliveries may be created by clients. Other kinds are refused.

events.description: Canonical event selectors. Unknown or retired selectors are refused before creation.

url.description: HTTPS URL to receive events for this subscription.

CreateWebhookResponse.description:
Response after creating a webhook. Store the shown-once `whsec_<base64>` secret now.
Standard Webhooks signs `"<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw body>"` with the decoded
key bytes, sending `webhook-signature: v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>`. No legacy headers are sent.

secret.description: Present only on the first response; receipts and replays contain null.

secretShownOnce.description: True even when the secret has been withheld on replay.

CredentialAuth.description:
How the presented credential authenticated.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

CreditAdmissionRefusal.description: A credit refusal retains its operands through API and quote-source projection.

available.description: Available credit at the time of refusal, as a decimal string in the credit line's denomination when calculable.

cause.description: More specific reason for the refusal, omitted when none was recorded.

component.description: Part of the credit check that blocked admission, when known.

creditCheck.description: Credit calculation behind the refusal, omitted when a check could not be completed.

fix.description: Suggested action to address the refusal, omitted when no suggestion is available.

lastGoodReadAt.description: Time of the last successful observation relevant to this refusal, when known.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of why the credit check could not admit the trade.

required.description: Credit required for the proposed trade, as a decimal string in the credit line's denomination when calculable.

shortfall.description: Amount by which required credit exceeds available credit, when calculable.

source.description: Source of the refusal evidence, when known.

venueAccountId.description: Identifier of the venue account the refusal applies to.

CreditAmount.description: A credit amount: the amount and its asset.

amount.description: Amount as a decimal string in `asset` units.

asset.description: The asset the amount is in.

lineValue.description: Equivalent decimal value in the credit line's denomination, omitted when no conversion is provided.

CreditCheck.description: Point-in-time credit evidence, never a reservation or dispatch authority.

activeHolds.description: Credit committed to active reservations and trades, as a decimal string in the credit line's denomination.

available.description: Spendable credit after active commitments, floored at zero, as a decimal string in the credit line's denomination.

availableSigned.description: Lower of `lpAvailable` and `localHeadroom` minus `activeHolds`, as a signed decimal string in the credit line's denomination.

checkedAt.description: Time at which the credit check was made.

stages.description: The ordered window walk, from durable statement, payment and movement records.

matching.description: Evidence used to compare payment and counterparty delivery under the matching rule.

readAt.description: Time the matching detail was read.

unappliedMovements.description: Final correlated movements on the account that have an unapplied balance.

behindSince.description:

discrepancy.description: Explanation of a delivery mismatch, or null when no discrepancy is reported.

eligibleDeliveryUsdValue.description: USD value the counterparty is eligible to deliver, as a decimal string when available.

oneOf.description:
How the counterparty's side follows ours under the account's rule; absent while the

expectation.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

expectedBy.description: `behindSince` plus the relationship's answer time (its settlement terms).

expectedFromCounterparty.description:
Per asset chosen to take, what the counterparty should have sent back in total for what
has arrived from us: the rule's permitted amount plus what it already delivered. Absent
under `none`, and under `afterAll` until every obligation is met.

oneOf.description:
Whether the arrival finality behind `behindSince` and `expectedBy` was read. While it is
`unreadable`, `behindSince` is absent: lateness is never assessed on unknown arrivals.
Absent while the evidence is unavailable (`reasonCode`).

finality.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

rule.description: Matching rule recorded for the venue account, or null when unconfirmed.

statementVersion.description: Version of the statement used for matching, or null when evidence is unavailable.

MatchingExpectation.description:
How the counterparty's side is linked to ours: `valueLinked` (each paid dollar releases one

NextAction.description:
What the order needs from its reader next. Absent when nothing is needed.

Each variant is a distinct situation with a distinct remedy; none collapses onto
another, and a state the backend cannot decide yields no action rather than a
`signNextLeg` it cannot back.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

NextActionFinishTrade.description:
The route ended with the funds in the taker's wallet part-way, and no re-quote
owner can resume it: finish the trade from there with a new order.

fundsAt.description: Funds recovered mid-route that the taker can use in a new order.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

reason.description: Recorded reason the route did not complete on this order.

NextActionPayoutFeeRose.description: The payout remains unsent with its venue-account hold retained.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

tradeLegId.description:
The unsent payout leg whose fee increased: the payment leg's own id
(`TradeLegFacts.tradeLegId`), never a route leg's `legId`.

NextActionPriceMoved.description: The fresh price moved past the tolerance. The taker may accept it once.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

offer.description: Fresh price and acceptance details for the current leg attempt.

NextActionProvideDestination.description: A bound wallet destination is no longer usable. Funds remain at the LP.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason the recorded destination can no longer be used.

tradeLegId.description:
The payout leg that needs a replacement destination: the payment leg's own id
(`TradeLegFacts.tradeLegId`), never a route leg's `legId`.

NextActionRetryNextLeg.description:
A leg did not run and the funds came back to the taker: sign it again, on the
same order.

attempt.description: The attempt the retry starts (the ended attempts plus one).

fundsAt.description: Where funds are available for the retry, omitted when the location is not recorded.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

legId.description: The leg to retry, as the order names it in `legs[].legId`.

reason.description: Recorded reason the prior leg attempt did not complete.

NextActionSignNextLeg.description:
The taker signs the next leg. On an FX-first order that has not started, the leg is
the route's first (`legs[0]`): its funds are still in the taker's wallet.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

legId.description: The leg awaiting the taker's signature, as the order names it in `legs[].legId`.

NextActionStopped.description: The taker stopped waiting, or the wait reached its bound.

fundsAt.description: Where funds were left when the order stopped, omitted when not recorded.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

reason.description: Why the order stopped progressing.

NextActionSupportReview.description: An operator must review the order; the taker cannot act on it.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

reason.description: Recorded reason the order needs support review instead of another client action.

NextActor.description:
Who must act before the order can progress, shared by the order read and list.

subject.description: Suggested subject for the reminder email.

RFC 6749 section 5.2 error identifiers, plus the standard temporary-unavailability code.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OAuthErrorResponse.description: An RFC 6749 error response: the token endpoint answers the standard's body, not `ApiError`.

error.description:
The RFC 6749 error code: `invalid_client` (401), `invalid_grant`, `unsupported_grant_type`
or `unauthorized_client` (400), or `temporarily_unavailable` (503).

error_description.description: Why the client was refused, when the RFC 6749 code alone does not say.

error_uri.description:
The error-code reference for a TetraFi cause the RFC 6749 code does not name
(`SIGNED_KEY_NOT_EXCHANGEABLE`).

OAuthTokenRequest.description:
An RFC 6749 client-credentials token request, form-encoded. Its field names are the
standard's, so OAuth client libraries send it unchanged.

client_id.description: The service account's id. Omit it when the credentials are sent with HTTP Basic.

client_secret.description:
The service account's full API key (`tfk_live_…` or `tfk_test_…`). Omit it when the
credentials are sent with HTTP Basic.

access_token.description: The bearer token: send it as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the token expires (at most 900). Request a new one before then.

ObligationClosure.description:
Why an obligation closed without any delivery: never a receipt or a met time.
`keptAtVenue` names its keep request; `nettedInto` names both windows and the unpaid
remainder a later window's cumulative position took over (what was matched stays matched).
A `nettedInto` closure with `remainingAmount` above zero is an open residual: a payment
matched before the netting was reversed, and that amount is owed on this obligation again.

fromWindowId.description: The window that created this obligation.

intoWindowId.description: The window whose snapshot position took over the unpaid remainder.

keepRequestId.description: The keep request whose recorded LP confirmation allowed the keep.

nettedAmount.description: The exact unpaid remainder passed into the later window.

reason.description: Why the obligation closed without delivery: funds stayed at the venue or netted into another window.

recordedAt.description: Time the closure was recorded, not a delivery time.

ObligationClosureReason.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ObligationConsequence.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ObligationDueBasis.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ObligationDueFacts.description: Deadline facts projected at read time with the stored row's deadline.

arrivalAt.description: Authoritative arrival of the latest final allocated movement.

consequencePolicy.description: Published consequences applicable to this obligation, or null when unavailable.

dueRefusal.description: A named cause when the policy or deadline facts could not be read.

dueStatus.description: Projected deadline status of the remaining obligation at read time.

lateFundsAmount.description:
Money credited to a lapsed pay-in after its deadline, exact, as the
fiat arrival owner recorded it (credit time in `arrival_at`). Never revives the price.

latePayment.description: True when a final allocated movement arrived after the deadline.

lpDelivery.description:
An LP-paid residual against the schedule's delivery promise; absent when the
schedule makes none.

needsReview.description:
The obligation's deadline task kept refusing and stopped for review; its
named cause is in `due_refusal` and `due_state` is `unavailable`.

observedAt.description: When TetraFi observed that movement, which may be after the deadline.

originalWindowId.description: The window whose statement created this obligation; late payments meet it.

overdueSince.description: The confirmed deadline itself once the residual is past it.

payInDifference.description:
With `dueRefusal` `PAY_IN_AMOUNT_MISMATCH`: whether the on-time payment
exceeds or falls short of the agreed amount, and by how much. Absent when
the recorded arrival no longer shows an on-time amount that differs.

remindersPaused.description: Reminders and overdue escalation are paused for this obligation only.

ObligationDueState.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

originId.description: For a carry fee, the carried window, not the receiving window.

version.description: For a carry fee, the relationship terms version effective at the carried send-by.

ObligationOriginKind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ObligationParty.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ObligationState.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

ObservationCounterparty.description:
An observation of counterparty progress under the window's matching rule, not a stored
lifecycle. The plan, window and messages all read this matching evidence.

behindSince.description: Time the counterparty first fell behind without catching up, or null when lateness is not established.

expected.description: Total expected delivery by asset, or null when the matching rule gives no expectation yet.

expectedBy.description: Time the counterparty is expected to catch up under the settlement terms, or null when no deadline applies.

received.description: Final counterparty deliveries observed so far, grouped by asset.

status.description: Counterparty progress under the matching rule, including unreadable arrival evidence.

OnChainSettlementSection.description:
Section B: On-chain settlement data.

Models the four-step lifecycle of an intent on-chain: `submit_tx` (user
deposit / intent creation), `fill_tx` (solver fill on destination chain),
`proof_tx` (cross-chain proof submission), `finalise_tx` (claim/settle on
origin). Oracle + settlement_stage describe the proof-relay layer.

cexLane.description: Confirmed CEX ledger stages, including venue evidence and the DDR v2 forward.

failureReason.description: A human-readable failure reason when status is `failed` or `refunded`.

fillTx.description: Recorded transaction that filled the intent on the receiving network, when available.

finaliseTx.description: Recorded transaction that finalised settlement on the originating network, when available.

oracle.description: Cross-network proof relay details, when recorded.

proofTx.description: Recorded transaction that submitted the cross-network settlement proof, when available.

recipientWallet.description: Address of the receiving wallet, when recorded.

settlementSpeedSeconds.description: Settlement duration in seconds (millisecond precision), when recorded.

status.description: Where the order's recorded settlement stands.

submitTx.description: Recorded transaction that submitted or funded the intent, when available.

transactions.description:
Generic per-stage transaction list — the full timeline for ANY order kind
(escrow quartet, bridge/relay/FX legs, composite hops), each row enriched with
a `label`, an `explorerUrl`, and a `legId`. The escrow-shaped
`submit/fill/proof/finalise` refs above stay for back-compat; this list is what
non-escrow (router/composite/FX) orders render, and it is empty (not a wall of
"—") when an order has no recorded transactions.

userDepositWallet.description: Recorded funding wallet address for the order, when available.

messageId.description: Identifier of the proof message, when recorded.

name.description: Display name of the cross-network proof relay.

status.description: Reported status of cross-network proof delivery, when recorded.

OrderChannel.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

allOf.description: Catalogue venue and method of this order; unknown historical membership is explicit.

fees.description:
The fees actually charged, as recorded: the venue's own fee report, bridge fees, network
gas the order's wallet paid, and the platform fee. Never a quoted estimate. A fee whose
amount was not reported or could not be read is left out rather than shown as 0, and its
kind is listed in `unrecordedFees`.

fills.description:
Each confirmed fill, in execution order. Always present: empty before any fill is
confirmed.

quotedBuyAmount.description:
The buy amount the executed quote said would land. Null when it is not known (for
example before a venue order is dispatched).

settledBuyAmount.description:
What actually landed, read from the fill or settlement evidence. Null until it is
measured; never the quote carried forward and never 0 for unknown.

settlesBy.description:
The latest time the order settles, or can no longer execute, under its recorded terms:
the signed order's fill deadline, or, on a route, the latest fill deadline every leg
commits to (Advanced); the last on-chain step's send-by time (an on-chain Basic swap).
Null when no such term is recorded, for example a same-chain DEX swap, whose call
carries no deadline.

unrecordedFees.description:
Every fee kind the order incurs whose actual charge is not recorded or could not be
read: a venue fee taken inside the price without an amount, a bridge leg's fee, gas
the order's wallet spent without a readable receipt, a platform fee billed off the
order. Always present; empty only when every incurred charge is in `fees`. An absent
kind with no `fees` line means nothing of that kind was charged. Open set: clients
show an unknown kind generically.

OrderExecutionReport.description: Flattened into both order kinds' envelopes: its keys are the envelope's own keys.

amount.description: Decimal amount in `asset`.

asset.description: Asset in which `amount` is denominated.

includedInPrice.description:
True when the venue took this fee inside its price: the fill amounts already reflect
it, so it is not charged on top of them.

kind.description: What the charge or rebate paid for, such as trading or network gas.

network.description: The CAIP-2 network the fee was paid on, for an on-chain charge.

OrderFeeKind.description:
What a fee paid for.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderFill.description: One confirmed fill: what it delivered, what it spent and where.

amount.description:
The buy Asset amount this fill delivered. Null when the fill is confirmed but nothing
measured its delivery.

at.description:
The recorded fill time: the venue's fill time or the time the fill transaction was
observed. Null when no fill time was recorded.

fillId.description:
Stable identity of this native dispatch or recorded route-leg fill. A row is one
fill, never a running total; retain this id when deduplicating repeated order reads.

legId.description:
The leg this fill executed, as the quote named it in `legs[].legId`: `leg_0` on a
single-leg order, the route leg's id on a route.

network.description: The CAIP-2 chain of `txHash`; absent off-chain.

oneOf.description:
The executed price in market convention (quote units per one base unit). Null when
either amount is unknown.

price.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

sellAmount.description: The sell Asset amount this fill spent. Null when it was not recorded.

txHash.description: The fill's or settlement's on-chain transaction; absent off-chain.

venue.description: Venue that executed this fill. A multi-venue order names each fill's own venue here.

OrderFillPrice.description: An executed price: `amount` units of `quote` for one unit of `base`.

amount.description: Executed price as a decimal string: units of the quote asset per one unit of the base asset.

base.description: Asset used as the denominator of the executed price.

quote.description: Asset used as the numerator of the executed price.

OrderFillVenue.description: The venue that executed the fill, by the same id and name its quote carried.

id.description: Identifier of the venue that executed the fill.

name.description: Display name of the venue that executed the fill.

OrderLegExternalRef.description: An off-chain provider reference for a leg.

kind.description: Reference kind, e.g. `circleTradeId` | `acrossDepositId` | `relayRequestId`.

url.description: A provider status URL for `value`, when one is known.

value.description: Identifier assigned by the provider for the reference named by `kind`.

OrderLegExternalRefKind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

buy.description:
What the leg quote ESTIMATED this leg would buy. Always the quote: a confirmed
delivery is reported separately in `measuredBuy` rather than overwriting this,
so the two facts stay distinguishable on the wire.

counterparty.description:
Per-leg counterparty compliance posture — WHO filled this leg and their
regulatory standing. Absent on the generic `OrderResponse`; populated only
on the admin company trade-detail. Lets a composite show "leg 1 = KYB'd
Solver X (Cayman Islands), leg 2 = CCTP protocol" instead of one collapsed
counterparty.

destNetwork.description: The destination chain as its registry CAIP-2 id; absent when the registry does not list it.

etaSeconds.description:
The route quote's per-leg ETA in seconds, when it carried one: the venue's
estimate of this leg's own execution. For a CCTP leg it is the burn-to-mint
upper bound of the chosen finality tier, set by the source chain (Fast ~20 s;
Standard ~19 min from the L1-anchored chains). It never counts the time a
parked route waits for its taker to sign the next leg.

externalRefs.description:
Off-chain provider references for the leg (Circle trade id, Across deposit id,
Relay request id, …) — the identifiers a client uses to look the leg up on the
provider's own status surface.

feeUsd.description:
Concrete USD-denominated fee total for this leg. Absent when the route
quote only carried spread/fee bps or a non-USD fee asset.

index.description: 0-indexed position in the route's execution order.

kind.description:
Normalised leg mechanism: `cctp` | `across` | `relay` | `fx` | `solver`, or the
raw `providerProduct` for a kind the backend does not special-case (clients must
treat this as an open set and fall back to a generic presentation).

label.description: Human-friendly leg label, e.g. `"Circle CCTP Fast"` or `"CCTP: Base → Arc"`.

legId.description:
The route leg's id, the `legId` its quote published in `legs[]`, so a quote leg, this
leg and its fill join on it. Absent only on a record that did not retain it.

measuredBuy.description:
What this leg was OBSERVED to deliver, from the settlement receipt TetraFi
recorded for this leg, in the leg's buy asset. Absent until that receipt has
confirmed the leg, which a client must render as "not measured": never as
zero, and never by silently showing `buy` in its place.

This is the only place an INTERMEDIATE leg's real delivery appears. On a
`StableFX -> CCTP` composite the FX leg settles a different asset on a
different chain from the order's own output, so the order-level delivery
cannot describe it.

measuredBuySource.description:
Which settlement receipt backed `measuredBuy`: `circleSettledOutput`
| `cctpVerifiedOutput` | `relayVerifiedOutput` | `solverVerifiedOutput`
| `nativeUniswapOutcome`. Carried so an operator can trace a per-leg number back
to the observation that produced it instead of inferring it from the leg kind.

product.description:
The venue product of a firm-RFQ leg: `lop` (Octarine limit order) | `rfq` (Bebop
PMM RFQ) | `bopamm` (Bebop BopAMM). Read from the handoff persisted for the leg,
so it is absent until the venue firmed it and on every non-RFQ leg. An open set:
a client renders an unknown value generically.

provider.description: Venue / provider display name for the leg.

sell.description:
What the leg sells: its asset, chain and `decimalAmount`, or `unresolved` when
the backend cannot scale it.

sourceNetwork.description: The source chain as its registry CAIP-2 id; absent when the registry does not list it.

status.description: Leg status: `pending` | `executing` | `done` | `failed` | `refunded`.

tradeLeg.description:
The money-movement facts of a hosted venue trade's leg: a
payout or pay-in over a bank rail or a chain. Absent on route legs.

transactions.description:
The transactions this leg produced (a subset of the order's `transactions[]`,
correlated by `legId`, else by chain), each already enriched with an explorer URL.

venueRouteId.description:
The venue route identity that filled this leg, from the retained route quote's
`legQuotes[].solverId`. A solver-LP leg carries a real solver id that
resolves to a KYB'd LP workspace; a bridge leg carries a synthetic id
(e.g. `"circle-cctp"`) with no LP workspace behind it. This is the handle
the trade-detail builder uses to resolve per-leg counterparty compliance.

OrderLegKind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderLegMeasuredBuySource.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderLegProduct.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderLegStatus.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderListKind.description: Which native owner holds an order.

OrderListResponse.description:
A page of the workspace's orders, newest first. A status filter keeps reading until the page
has `limit` items or the orders end, within a bounded scan: a page shorter than `limit` with a
`nextCursor` means that scan reached its limit, never that the orders ended. `nextCursor` is
absent only on the last page.

items.description: Orders matching the request, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor for the same query, or null when the scan has reached the end.

OrderRequestBody.description: The required `kind` selects `quote` (order a held quote by its `quoteId`) or `stream` (order a tradable Live prices row by its `priceId`).

OrderRequestBodyQuote.description: The strict order body: name a held quote and supply only the approval or evidence it asks for.

acknowledgeHighSlippage.description:
The person accepts a `minReceive` more than 10% below the venue card's receive amount.
Without it such an order is refused (`HIGH_SLIPPAGE_ACK_REQUIRED`). The workspace's
maximum slippage binds whatever this says (`WORKSPACE_SLIPPAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`). Only a
venue card's `minReceive` reads it.

clientOrderId.description:
Caller reference, 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Unique in
this workspace while the order is non-terminal; independent of Idempotency-Key.

continuesOrderId.description:
The earlier multi-leg order this one finishes ("Finish this trade",
`metadata.continuesOrderId`). The order path refuses it unless that order is asking its
taker to finish and this order spends exactly the funds it left. Protocol quotes only.

firstStep.description:
The quote's `signing.firstStep`, signed with the source wallet the client holds, as a
`signedTransaction` (`raw`) or a `signature` (a `typedData` step). Optional on a quote whose
`signing.mode` is `you`, refused on any other quote. Without it the order opens with
`next: sign` for step 1, which a browser wallet answers on the step route (a wallet that
sends the transaction itself answers there with `transactionHash`). The order re-checks a
signed first step against the chain before relaying it: when the chain moved since the
quote (a nonce, an allowance, a stricter `minReceive`), nothing is sent and the order
answers `next: sign` with the step to sign now.

funding.description:
`depositFirst` on a fiat venue card whose LP balance is short. Instead of
refusing FUNDING_SHORTFALL, the order records the person's consent to trade the
card's exact debit at no less than its receipt floor once their bank deposit is
credited; nothing is sent to the venue now. Absent is today's order. Human only.

fundingDepositId.description:
The Treasury payout that topped up this card's venue account from one of the workspace's
company wallets (the payoutId from `POST …/treasury/payouts`), recorded as what funded the
trade. It must exist in this workspace, pay into this card's venue account from a company
wallet in the card's debit asset, of at least the card's debit amount, and have completed;
a deposit still awaiting approval, in flight or partly done refuses
(`FUNDING_DEPOSIT_NOT_CREDITED`). One deposit funds one order (`FUNDING_DEPOSIT_ALREADY_USED`)
until that order ends without a fill. A resumed order (one naming tradePreparationId) that omits it
keeps the deposit its preparation already names. Only with funding absent or set to balance.
Venue cards only.

kind.description: `quote`.

minReceive.description:
The least the person accepts to receive, in receive-Asset units. Required when
the quote's `minReceiveRequired` is true. Other venue cards may accept it as an
explicit execution bound; protocol quotes refuse it.

onBehalfOf.description:
The principal the order trades for: the client workspace id a broker's quote was
requested for (the quote request's `onBehalfOf`). Optional, since the quote already binds
it; when sent it must equal the quote's, or the order is refused with
`DIRECT_USER_MISMATCH` and nothing is placed.

ownerAuthorization.description:
The pay wallet owner's approval, when the held binding pays from an embedded
wallet (personal or organisation). The server names the wallet from the binding;
this carries only the owner's factor: the hosted approval preflight prepared
(`walletAuthorization.authorizationId`), or an operation-bound RPC factor. Exclusive with
`signature`. Protocol quotes only.

priceProtectionBps.description:
Protocol price protection in basis points (1..=1000). May tighten, but never
loosen, the held quote's protection without requesting a new price.

quoteId.description: The held quote's id (`q_` and a ULID), as `POST /quotes` returned it.

settlementWindowId.description:
The settlement window the trader consents to on a quote that carries a settlement window
(a delayed-settlement venue trade). Absent, the quote's own window is the consent. After a
409 `SETTLEMENT_WINDOW_CHANGED`, resend the same quote with this set to
`details.currentWindow.windowId` from that refusal. Refused on a quote that settles
immediately (`SETTLEMENT_WINDOW_NOT_APPLICABLE`).

signature.description:
The taker's signature over the quote's `next.sign.typedData`; required exactly when
`next` was `sign`.

sourceAuthorizationId.description:
An authorization this server issued at preflight for this quote's source leg (a
source permit on networks that need one, or a programmable execution's key). Protocol
quotes only.

sourceTransaction.description:
The identifier of a source transaction the member's wallet already broadcast on the
quote's pay network, in that network's own form (its transaction hash, or its signature
where the network names transactions by signature) of a route's source, a programmable
execution, or a relayed source answered as awaiting finality. The order registers it
and never broadcasts again; the server verifies it on chain. Protocol quotes only.

stepUpProof.description:
A `trade_authorization` step-up proof for a venue card, bound to the
confirmation key the refusal's `stepUp` names (`MFA_STALE`, `STEP_UP_REQUIRED`); the
quote stays held for this retry. Ignored for a protocol quote.

tradePreparationId.description:
A venue trade this member already prepared on the quote's venue connection
(for example one a Treasury review has since approved), so the order continues that
preparation instead of preparing a new one. It must be the caller's, in this workspace,
on the held quote's connection, with bounds that cover the held quote. Venue cards only.

travelRule.description:
The Travel Rule data the member supplies for this transfer
(`metadata.travelRule`). Protocol quotes only.

OrderRequestBodyStream.description:
The strict stream order body (`kind: "stream"`): a `priceId` and exactly one limit,
`minReceive` or `slippageBps`.

acknowledgeHighSlippage.description: Accepts a limit more than 10% below the venue's receive amount, as on a quote order.

clientOrderId.description: Caller reference, 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, as on a quote order.

kind.description: `stream`.

minReceive.description:
The least the order accepts to receive, in receive-Asset units. Send exactly one limit:
this or slippageBps.

priceId.description:
A tradable Live prices row's id for one size, ordered before its validFor lapses.
Refusals: 400 PRICE_ID_INVALID (altered, or issued to another workspace) and 409
PRICE_EXPIRED, both before any venue is asked; 409 PRICE_ACCOUNT_NOT_PRICED when the
venue account it was read on has no orderable price now (it orders only that account).

slippageBps.description:
The limit as a tolerance below the receive amount the price id states, in basis points
(0 to 9999); the minimum receive is rounded up to the Asset's precision.

OrderStep.description:
One step of an order (`operation.steps[]`), for every order, client-signed and
TetraFi-signed alike: what was asked of the signing wallet, who signs it, which leg it
belongs to, where it stands, and the transaction and refusal facts behind it. The order's
one step history. Its values are the
camelCase wire projection of the stored step (`order_step_wire`), never the stored tokens.

authority.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

browserHandedOutAt.description: When the step was handed to the External wallet to sign.

browserNonce.description: The wallet nonce pinned when the step opened for an External or client wallet.

browserSigningRequested.description: A connected External wallet must sign this step; no platform grant is used.

cancellationTxHash.description:
The reported cancellation hash after finalized chain proof confirms that exact
transaction consumed this step's pinned nonce. Absent otherwise.

confirmationTimeReason.description: Why the block or receipt observation time is unavailable or unreadable.

confirmedAt.description: When the mined receipt was stored, not its block time. Null for historical receipts.

legId.description: The leg this step belongs to.

minedAt.description: Timestamp of the receipt's canonical block. Null when it was unavailable.

network.description: CAIP-2 network of the step's wallet and transaction.

oneOf.description: Why the step was refused or lapsed, by name.

refusal.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

oneOf.description:
Set when, after the order ended, the chain at finality disagrees with how this step was
recorded. The order's outcome stays as it ended; TetraFi reviews the difference. Null
otherwise.

review.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

sequence.description: 1 for the first step, in execution order.

signBy.description: When the step lapses if nothing was handed in.

signer.description:
Who signs this step: `you` when the client signs it with its own wallet (through the
API or a member's connected browser wallet), `tetrafi` when TetraFi signs it under the
wallet's signing grant.

summary.description: What the step does in the venue's words: its detailed purpose, amounts and limits.

oneOf.description: The platform send's progress: broadcasts, replacement and which transaction landed.

transaction.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

txHash.description: The step's transaction, once one was handed to the network.

Which owner-granted authority produced the step's signature or send. New kinds may be

OrderStepReview.description:
A difference between a step's recorded outcome and the chain at finality, found after its
order ended.

checkedAt.description: When the chain was read at finality.

txHash.description:
The transaction the difference is about: for `lapsedButMined` the step's own transaction
the chain shows mined; for `receiptChanged` the transaction recorded for the step.

OrderStepReviewReason.description:
Why a step is under review. New values may be added; treat an unknown value as other.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

Where a step stands. New values may be added; treat an unknown value as other.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderStepSummary.description: What a step does, in the terms the member reads before it is signed.

executionTypeId.description: The execution type requesting this wallet step.
