pay.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

recipient.description:
Who receives the trade's output; the organisation wallet itself in
venue-account mode.

spender.description: The contract allowed to move the wallet's tokens (FxEscrow, Permit2).

OrderStepTransaction.description:
The platform send's progress: safe transaction evidence only, never an unsigned body,
raw bytes or factors.

failureData.description: Structured safe operands, never a provider response body.

oneOf.description:
Which of the two transactions the canonical receipt names once one landed. The other
is replaced, never a failure.

landed.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

replacementFailureCode.description:
Why the stuck send got no replacement, or why its replacement stopped:
`REPLACEMENT_FEE_ABOVE_APPROVED_CAP`, `REPLACEMENT_FEE_CAP_NOT_APPROVED`, a provider
refusal. The send stays stuck for a person's re-send.

replacementTxHash.description:
The hash of the one fee-raised replacement of a stuck send (same nonce, signed by the
same wallet within the grant's approved network-fee cap), once it was handed to the
network. Null when the send was never replaced.

signedTxHash.description:
The transaction that moved the funds: the original send's hash, or its
replacement's once the replacement is the one that landed.

status.description: The send's lifecycle status.

OrderStepTransactionStatus.description:
Where the platform send stands. Independent from typed-data signatures and the trade's
outcome: a signed hash alone is not a broadcast receipt. New values may be added; treat an
unknown value as other.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderTransactionActor.description:
Actor that submitted a lifecycle transaction.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderTransactionChainRole.description:
Chain role for a lifecycle transaction.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

allOf.description:
The transaction's chain: `network` (its registry CAIP-2 id) or, for a chain the registry
does not list, `networkUnsupported` (the raw chain id).

explorerUrl.description:
Block-explorer URL for `hash` when TetraFi knows the chain's explorer; when absent, the
client falls back to its own per-chain explorer list.

label.description:
Human-friendly role label (e.g. "Bridge burn", "Fill", "Claim"); when absent the client
derives it from `stage`.

legId.description:
The leg this transaction belongs to, as the order names it in `legs[].legId` and
`execution.fills[].legId` (on a route, the id its quote published for that leg;
`unrecorded-leg-<position>` for a retained leg that kept no id). Absent when the
transaction is not attributed to one leg.

timestamp.description:
RFC 3339 UTC time at which the platform OBSERVED this transaction: when TetraFi recorded
it, never the block time.

Absent when TetraFi does not know when the transaction happened. A client must render
"time unknown" then, never substitute a time of its own (such as the order's `updatedAt`).

OrderTransactionInfo.description:
A transaction in an order's timeline, for one lifecycle stage.

`legId`, `label` and `explorerUrl` are optional: they tell a client which route leg the
transaction belongs to, a human role label, and a ready-to-open explorer URL.

OrderTransactionStage.description:
Order lifecycle stage that a transaction belongs to.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderTransactionStatus.description:
Transaction status for an order lifecycle stage.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderUpdatedWebhook.description: One immutable order status transition. Deduplicate by id and read data.statusUrl for the full order. Additional data fields may appear under the same apiVersion.

apiVersion.description:
The TetraFi-Version this webhook endpoint pinned when it was created; every body it receives is in that version.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

id.description: Event identifier to use when deduplicating deliveries.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened, not when delivery was attempted.

type.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderUpdatedWebhookData.description: `data` of `order.updated`: one order status transition. Read `statusUrl` for the full order.

clientOrderId.description: Caller reference retained by the order, when supplied.

next.description:
The step a client-signed order waits for the client to sign at this transition; read the
order for the step itself. Absent when nothing waits on the client.

notSentReason.description: The order owner's reason the trade was not dispatched, when present.

orderId.description: Canonical order identity, shared with the order read.

settlement.description:
A basicTrade's settlement terms recorded before it was sent, as the order read returns
them: method, timing and, for a delayed trade, its window.

settlementStatus.description:
Where a filled basicTrade's settlement stands at this transition. A delayed trade keeps
status `filled` (terminal false) until this reaches `settled` or `failed`, and an event
follows each settlement step.

status.description: The public status the order read returns at this transition.

statusUrl.description: Relative URL for the full order read.

terminal.description: Whether the order has ended: no later transition changes its outcome.

OrderWebhookKind.description:
Which order an `order.updated` event concerns.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OrderWebhookNext.description:
The action the order waits for from its client at this transition, by the order's own
`next.kind`. Read the order for the full action.

kind.description:
The order's `next.kind`: `sign` today. New values may appear; treat an unknown value as
"read the order".

sequence.description: The step's position in the order, from 1. Present for `sign`.

stepId.description: The open step, as the order's `next.step.stepId`. Present for `sign`.

accountId.description: The wallet's Treasury inventory account, once published.

entitlementId.description:
Derived from the setup request, so a repeat is the same grant. Present
from `pending` on.

reason.description: Code explaining why the trading grant could not proceed, when available.

status.description: Whether the creator's trading grant was requested and its current progress.

OrganizationSetupCreatorTradeGrantState.description:
Where the creator's chosen `trade` grant stands. Nothing here is a grant:
the right exists only as the wallet's installed operating grant (`written`).

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

oneOf.description: Credit identified in the bank feed, omitted when no matched credit is reported.

matchedBy.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

reviewItemId.description: Identifier of the retained review item, when one exists for the discrepancy.

source.description: Bank feed used for the independent check.

status.description: Independent bank check result: verified, not seen, unavailable, or in disagreement with the venue report.

OwnBankVerificationMatchedBy.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OwnBankVerificationSource.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

OwnBankVerificationState.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

amount.description: Exact decimal text, never a floating-point approximation.

asset.description: The credited asset (its currency code).

creditedAt.description: When the bank reported the funds credited.

referenceMasked.description: Masked reference for the matched bank credit, if available.

OwnerGroupChoice.description:
The owner group as the person picked it: the people, how many of them must
approve, and the confirmations the threshold count depends on.

countedPerMember.description:
The people the creator confirmed count once per member they appear as
("this person counts twice"); every owner sees it. Absent: every person counts once.

members.description: Members selected for the wallet's owner group and how each approves.

minMemberFactors.description: "Each member has at least N factors": an alert to the owners, never a block on approvals.

threshold.description: How many people must approve. It counts people, not members.

OwnerGroupMemberChoice.description:
One person of the owner group being created and the factors they approve with,
`needed` of them.

factors.description: Factors this member can use to approve, empty when they choose later or approve with a wallet.

needed.description: Number of the member's chosen factors required to approve.

walletId.description:
The person approves with one of their own wallets instead of sign-in
methods: its TetraFi wallet id (`factors` empty, `needed` 1). Named only by
that person: the creator for themselves when asking, an invited person when
picking. The key it approves with is read from the wallet's provider when
the person approves adding it on their signing page, never sent.

items.description: Page of retained delivery records, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page of retained deliveries, or `null` on the last page.

totalCount.description: Number of delivery records in the retained log, not a lifetime total.

PaginatedWebhooks.description: A cursor page of workspace webhook endpoints.

items.description: Webhook endpoints on this page of the workspace subscription list.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page of endpoints, or `null` on the last page.

PairEntry.description: One directed asset pair: sell `sell`, buy `buy` (catalogue asset ids, as `GET /assets` lists).

connectableVenues.description:
With `availability=connectable` only: the venues that would serve the pair once the
workspace connects one (`notConnected`), finishes its setup (`pending`) or resumes trading
on it (`paused`). These are never quoted.

id.description:
The pair's stable id: the sell asset id, `~`, then the buy asset id (`USDC~ETH`). The order
is sell then buy, never base then quote: `ETH~USDC` is the other direction.

routes.description:
The routes of the workspace's enabled venues that serve the pair; a quote may be asked on
any of them. Absent with `availability=connectable`.

not.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Negated field-presence predicates for an optional flattened object, not wire variants.

allOf.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Optional flattened object: validates either the full block or absence of every block field; no separate wire value to tag.

advisories.description: Competing mechanisms' limitations remain visible even when one serves.

assurance.description: The bond backing the quote, separate from its firmness; absent when no bond is declared.

basis.description: Where the price came from: a live venue quote, published levels, or a model.

buy.description:
What the taker buys: `buy.amount` is what lands at `deliverTo`, after every
`included: true` fee taken in the bought Asset.

corridors.description:
The venue's other supported corridors; changing one is a Requote.
Absent when the venue declares no alternate corridor.

dayBudget.description:
This venue's firm-quote day budget for this workspace: firm asks used and
left, and the share kept for members who can place orders. Read without
contacting the provider; absent when the venue states no limits.

eta.description: Expected time to delivery (ISO 8601 duration); absent when the venue states none.

expiresAt.description:
When an executable quote stops being orderable; null for an indicative one and for a desk's
live price, which is executable but lapses by `staleAfter`.

failureHandling.description: What happens to the input if execution fails; absent when the venue states none.

fees.description:
Every fee line, its payer and whether `buy.amount` already includes it; an amount that could
not be read is null, never 0.

firmAsk.description:
When this card's venue gives its binding price, from the venue's own declaration:
`onRequest` (a desk is firm-asked by Get firm quote or a requote) or `atExecution`
(the venue prices firm only when the order executes, so Get firm quote is not offered).
Absent when no venue declares it (protocol routes, order books, fiat venues).

firmAskAvailableAt.description:
When this desk takes its next firm ask: its firm-quote limit for this workspace is reached
until then, so Get firm quote and an order-time ask are refused before it. Absent
when no limit is known here; the desk's admission still decides at ask time.

firmQuoteDailyWarning.description: Current workspace/venue firm asks, read without contacting the provider.

id.description:
The held quote's id (`q_` + ULID): order it with `POST /orders {quoteId}`, requote it with `POST /quotes {requote: id}`. It belongs to the
principal that asked; another principal reads it as unknown (404).

legs.description:
One leg per venue the quote runs through, in execution order: a multi-leg route (for example
CCTP then Circle StableFX) lists each leg's venue and location.
Empty only on a route card recorded before 2026-11-19, whose leg breakdown was not stored.

location.description: Where the quote executes, derived from its legs.

maxPay.description:
The most `sell.amount` a venue card asked by `buyAmount` may debit: the mirror of `minOut`, the quoted
debit grown by `priceProtectionBps`. It is the consent an order on it carries, so Confirm's
one fresh quote of an expired card is judged by it. Absent when asked by `sellAmount`.

mechanism.description: The native mechanism that actually supplied this venue's price.

oneOf.description:
The least `buy.amount` execution may deliver: from `priceProtectionBps` for a desk or
order-book card; for an AMM swap (a Basic Uniswap card), the shown receipt less
`slippageToleranceBps`, rounded up. On an indicative card it is a suggested minimum, not a
guaranteed floor. The swap signs its firm ask's fresh output less the tolerance; a delegated
order without `minReceive` signs the stricter of that and this value. The order's signed
minimum is its swap step's `summary.minReceive`.

minOut.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

minReceiveRequired.description:
Whether `POST /orders` requires `minReceive` for this card. A held firm offer
already supplies confirmation, and an AMM swap card (one with `slippageToleranceBps`) is
confirmed by the workspace's swap tolerance; other within-limit cards need the caller's minimum.

netReceived.description:
`buy.amount` minus every other cost, converted at the Reference mid: for
comparison and sort only, never what lands.

next.description:
The caller's next call: `preflight` (protocol), `order`, `requote` (a production venue's indicative
card: its firm quote comes from a requote), or what to fix first.

observedAt.description:
When the price was observed: an indicative price, or the book read an executable
order-book estimate (one that reprices when chosen) was priced from; null for a firm quote.

readiness.description: Whether the quote can be ordered now (funding, gas, wallet); an unknown is `unavailable`, never 0.

readyToTrade.description:
Whether an order on this card would find its prerequisites (order permission, the venue
key's trade permission, a fresh funds read) already current. Advisory: the order checks
them again. Present on a workspace venue card; absent on other quotes.

refundClaimableAfter.description:
With `refundOnSource` on an escrowed intent: the instant after which the source-chain
escrow refunds the input if the order was not filled, read from the signed order's own
expiry (`expires`). Until then the input stays in that escrow. Absent when the quote holds
no escrowed intent or its expiry could not be read; never estimated.

requoteOf.description:
The quote this one requoted (`POST /quotes {requote}`); the original stays orderable until its own
expiry, and a route's requote is that same route. Absent for a fresh quote.

retainUntil.description:
The last instant this held quote can still be requoted, or ordered where its lapse
allows it: its lapse plus the requote window (10 minutes), or the recovery window
(30 minutes) for a protocol quote. After it, requote and order answer 410
`REQUOTE_WINDOW_CLOSED` with `next: search` (request quotes again); before it, an
order past the quote's lapse answers 410 `QUOTE_EXPIRED` with `next: requote`. Read from the held quote's own retention, never computed by a client;
absent when that instant is not representable.

screening.description: The bound wallet's screening state; absent when no wallet is bound.

sell.description: What the taker sells: Asset, chain (null off-chain), variant and amount in Asset units.

signaturesRequired.description:
Every signature the order needs. `next.sign` carries the first; later ones arrive
on the order as `signNextLeg`.

sizeLimits.description: Provider bounds retained with this answer, never a current admission grant.

slippageToleranceBps.description:
The AMM swap tolerance `minOut` was taken at, in basis points: the workspace's
`swapSlippageToleranceBps` (default 50). Present only on a Basic Uniswap card.

spreadFromMidBps.description: The price's distance from the Reference mid, or the reason it is unknown.

staleAfter.description:
When an indicative price, or a desk's live executable price (`expiresAt` null), goes
stale; null for an executable quote that states `expiresAt`.

unspent.description:
What a card asked by `sellAmount` leaves unspent of the amount asked: an order book fills whole
lots, so the card spends less and the rest stays where it is paid from. Absent when the card
spends the whole amount.

walletSelection.description: Why each Basic on-chain wallet was selected. Response metadata, never request authority.

propertyNames.description:
A CAIP-2 chain id (`eip155:8453`, `solana:<genesis>`, `tron:shasta`), syntax-checked:
a namespace of 3 to 8 lowercase letters, digits or `-`, and a reference of 1 to 32
letters, digits, `-` or `_`. Compared exactly, as CAIP-2 references are case-sensitive.

PairQuote.description:
One venue's quote for the pair. Core price, identity and progress facts are always
present; venue-specific details are omitted when absent. Core timing fields that
do not apply to the quote's firmness remain `null`:

| field | indicative | executable, firm | executable, non-firm |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quality` | indicative | firm | executable |
| `expiresAt` | null | set | set |
| `minOut` | null | null | set |
| `observedAt`, `staleAfter` | set | null | null |

A stub (`sources[].priceOnRequest`) is indicative with `null` amounts.

The example is an executable non-firm quote: 10000 USDC paid,
`buy.amount` 9996.0 USDT lands after the included 4.0 USDT provider fee;
`netReceived` 9994.8 also subtracts the 0.0004 ETH network fee the taker pays
separately (`included: false`, about 1.2 USDT at the Reference mid), so it is lower
than `buy.amount`; `minOut` 9966.012 (30 bps, at USDT's 6 places) bounds `buy.amount`, not
`netReceived`.

PairQuoteRequest.description:
The public fresh `POST /quotes` body: what the taker sells and buys, and exactly one of
`sellAmount` (an exact-in quote) or `buyAmount` (an exact-out quote). Everything else
refines it.

buy.description: The Asset the taker buys, and optionally its chain.

buyAmount.description:
The exact amount to buy, a positive decimal string in Asset units. Exactly one of
`sellAmount` and `buyAmount`.

chosenWalletNetworks.description:
The networks whose `preferredWallets` entry the caller chose for this request itself (a trade
ticket's Pay from or Receive in), rather than a saved default. Quoting reads every
`preferredWallets` entry alike; this is recorded with the request and read back with it, so
the request can be asked again from the same wallets on another device.

deliverTo.description: Requested recipient of the bought asset, if explicitly selected.

filters.description: Optional restrictions on which venues, locations, prices, or asset variants to quote.

firmness.description:
Desk ask intent, independent of `filters.firmOnly`. Absent or `auto` preserves
automatic pricing; `indicative` never firm-asks; `firm` asks every eligible desk.

integrationAppId.description: Integration app whose fee terms apply, if explicitly named.

onBehalfOf.description: The principal a broker quotes for: a user or client workspace id.

preferredWallets.description:
Per CAIP-2 chain: a wallet the caller prefers to sell from, each `{wallet, signer?}` as in
`source.tradingWallets` (`wallet` is a financial-account id or the wallet's own address). A
preference, not a choice: a venue account uses it only where it is one of that account's
linked wallets on the venue's network, and otherwise quotes from its own default; a venue is
never refused because of it. A preference that names its `signer` is used as the paying
wallet's choice on the pay network. `source.tradingWallets` is the explicit choice and wins
on its chain.

propertyNames.description:
A CAIP-2 chain id (`eip155:8453`, `solana:<genesis>`, `tron:shasta`), syntax-checked:
a namespace of 3 to 8 lowercase letters, digits or `-`, and a reference of 1 to 32
letters, digits, `-` or `_`. Compared exactly, as CAIP-2 references are case-sensitive.

priceProtectionBps.description: The bound between a non-firm executable quote and what execution delivers.

sell.description: The Asset the taker sells, and optionally its chain.

sellAmount.description:
The exact amount to sell, a positive decimal string in Asset units. Exactly one of
`sellAmount` and `buyAmount` (400 `INVALID_REQUEST` naming both otherwise).

source.description: Trading wallets, venue account, or funding account selected for this request, if specified.

timeout.description:
Answer deadline, an ISO 8601 duration: the quote set is answered within this long of the
request's arrival, and a venue not priced by then is listed timed out. Default `PT6S`, which
answers as soon as every venue settled; at least 100 milliseconds and at most `PT10S`.

PairQuoteSet.description: The JSON reply, and the SSE `complete` event.

answeredFrom.description:
Where this request's answer came from, always sent: `venues` when at least one venue
was contacted (a live or firm ask), `cache` when every quote came from cache.

hint.description:
Set only when `quotes` is empty: what could bring prices. `NO_COUNTERPARTY_CONNECTED`
when the workspace has no venue enabled (connect one in Venues), `MORE_COUNTERPARTIES_AVAILABLE`
when it has some and others are available to connect. An empty answer is still a valid 200.

quoteRequestId.description:
The quote set's id (`rq_…`), read back at `GET /quotes/requests/{quoteRequestId}`.
The HTTP request id is separate (`X-Request-Id`, an error body's `requestId`).

quotes.description: Quote cards returned for this request, in the requested comparison order.

referenceMid.description:
The Reference mid this request's cards were priced against, read once per request.
Absent when the read failed or ran past its budget: the cards then read
`noReferenceMid`, never a spread of 0.

sourceOptions.description:
The trading wallets this caller may name in `source.tradingWallets`, per network:
each one's stored financial account (`acct_…`), scoped to the principal (an API key
sees only the organisation wallets granted to it). Sent even when no card was priced,
so an unbound request learns what to bind. Empty when none is usable.

sources.description: Every considered venue, with its outcome.

PairRouteEntry.description: One route that serves a pair: the venue and where it executes.

buyNetwork.description: CAIP-2 network the bought asset arrives on; absent off-chain.

legs.description: A `composite` route's legs, in order; absent for a single-venue route.

location.description:
Where the route executes: `singleChain`, `crossChain` or `offChain`. Treat a value you do
not know as a route you cannot filter on.

sellNetwork.description: CAIP-2 network the sold asset leaves from; absent off-chain.

venueId.description:
The venue entry that quotes this route, as quote sources name it (`binance-orderbook`).
`composite` for a route of several legs that no single venue serves alone: its venues are
on `legs`.

PairRouteLegEntry.description: One leg of a route of several legs.

buyNetwork.description: CAIP-2 network the leg arrives on.

sellNetwork.description: CAIP-2 network the leg leaves from.

venueIds.description: The venues of this workspace that serve the leg (any one of them may carry it).

PairsResponse.description:
The pairs the workspace can trade. A source the listing could not read is named in
`unreachable`, so a shorter list is never read as complete.

hint.description:
What would widen the listing: `NO_COUNTERPARTY_CONNECTED` when the workspace has enabled no
venue, `COUNTERPARTY_NOT_READY` when nothing is listed because each connected venue is
still being set up, paused, or needs Advanced while it is not available,
`MORE_COUNTERPARTIES_AVAILABLE` when other venues are available to connect. Absent
when every venue is enabled, or when a tradable source could not be read (see `unreachable`).

items.description: One page of pairs, ordered by sell then buy asset id.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

unreachable.description:
Empty when every source was read. Otherwise one entry per source not read: `source`
`venueMarkets` with the venue in `id`, or `venueEligibility`, `venueConnections`,
`assetCatalogue`, `advancedConnections` or `advancedRoutes`. `reason` is an open set:
`notReadYet` (the venue's first market read since a restart or key change is in flight:
read again in a few seconds), `unavailable` (the read failed: retry later) or, with
`availability=connectable`, `listedAfterConnection` (the venue lists its pairs only once
connected: connect it to see them). `details.ownerCode` keeps the source's own code.

PayBalance.description:
One chain's read of the sell Asset in the caller's Default-binding wallet.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

amount.description: Observed wallet balance as a decimal string in units of the sell asset.

network.description: CAIP-2 chain of the deployment read.

observedAt.description: When the wallet balance was observed.

status.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

PayBalanceUnavailable.description:
No measured amount is usable: `cold` (the first read is in flight), `expired`,
`failed`, `noRpc`, `noFetcher`, or a named chain read failure such as
`NATIVE_BALANCE_UNAVAILABLE`.

network.description: CAIP-2 network on which no usable wallet balance was available.

reason.description: Code explaining why there is no usable wallet balance.

status.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

clock.description: Whether payment must start or funds must arrive by the funding deadline.

seconds.description: Seconds from the quote to the venue's funding deadline, before any earlier venue expiry.

available.description: Whether direct wallet payment is available from statement review; currently false.

missingCapability.description: The missing capability when Pay is not available.

PayInAmountDifference.description:
How an on-time pay-in differs from the amount its obligation still requires,
read from the recorded arrival when the deadline worker refused it as
`PAY_IN_AMOUNT_MISMATCH`. `amount` is the exact difference, never rounded.

amount.description: Absolute difference as a decimal string in the obligation asset's units.

direction.description: Whether the on-time payment exceeded or fell short of the remaining amount due.

PayInDifferenceDirection.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

oneOf.description: Venue's treatment of late funds, or `null` when not declared.

oneOf.description: `null` means the venue declares no deadline, not an inferred duration.

payBy.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

oneOf.description: Venue's allowance for an on-time payment to arrive, or `null` when not declared.

settlementGrace.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

PayoutRailReferenceKind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

status.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

confirmationId.description: Identifier of the recipient's confirmation record.

tradeLegId.description: Identifier of the bank payout leg the recipient confirmed (`TradeLegFacts.tradeLegId`).

A custody account's operating rights a member can request.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

PermissionRequestBasis.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

PermissionRequestTarget.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

A right on a custody account (a workspace wallet the platform operates
through its custody provider), named by its financial account id. Its
account managers holding the treasury-policy permission decide.

accountId.description: Financial account identifier of the custody account on which the right is requested.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

right.description: Operating right requested on the custody account.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

right.description: Operating or read right requested on this wallet.

walletId.description: Identifier of the wallet on which the right is requested.

venueId.description: Identifier of the venue associated with the permission request, when supplied.

PlacementEffect.description:
Whether a refused order request placed anything. `noOrder`: this request placed nothing
(refused before any claim, hold or send, or its claim released with nothing sent); if an
earlier attempt with the same Idempotency-Key or quote may have been sent, recover it first.
`uncertain`: an order may exist (the request reached the claim or the venue, or another
request holds the quote or key); read the order back before sending another, and never
resend it with a new Idempotency-Key. An open set: absent or an unknown value means `uncertain`.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

PlanAccountStatus.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

accountName.description: Display name of the venue account.

complete.description: Whether the account's required settlement facts were read successfully.

lpEntityId.description: The venue enablement's LP entity, shared by every account of that LP. Null when unread.

lpName.description: The LP entity owner's display name. Null when unread.

lpWorkspaceId.description: The LP's linked TetraFi workspace. Null when it has no link, or when the named read failed.

openAmounts.description:
Full open position across all windows and the running position, not this page or the
horizon-limited `totals`. Includes overdue and disputed remaining amounts.
Null when an amount source could not be read; `failedReads` names it.

openWindowCount.description: Number of windows with open obligations or a pending statement past its snapshot.

How the account settles: `window` (its schedule's windows; also an account with no
schedule) or `anytime` (an on-demand schedule: no windows; its open amounts are the running
position, `settlement/positions/{venueAccountId}`). Null when the account's schedule could not
be read (`complete` is false and `failedReads` names it).

settlementMode.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

status.description: Whether the account has amounts open, is closed, or has nothing due.

venueAccountId.description: Identifier of the venue account covered by this summary.

venueId.description: Identifier of the venue where the account is held.

venueName.description: Display name of the venue where the account is held.

address.description: Deposit address for a crypto payment, or null for bank instructions.

bankInstructionsId.description: Identifier of the venue's bank instructions for this account and rail, or null for crypto payments.

confirmedAt.description: Time the destination instructions were confirmed.

instructionsStale.description:
The instructions come from the last good read, past its refresh time (a refresh is
due or failed). Paying re-reads them from the venue and refuses on any change.

provenance.description: Source from which the destination instructions were confirmed.

The plan's figures per asset over `[dayFrom, dayTo)`: the remaining amounts of the windows due
in it (an agreed LP-issued statement counts as due now). `complete` when every window due in
it was read and summed; `partial` names in `reasons` what is missing; `unavailable` serves no
figure.

byAsset.description: Remaining amounts to pay and receive by asset, empty when the totals are unavailable.

dayTo.description: Exclusive end of the totals period at UTC midnight.

asset.description: Asset the proposed payment would send.

balanceReadAt.description: Time of the most recent source balance observation, or null when no observation is known.

oneOf.description: Recorded destination instructions, or null when they are unavailable.

feeBudget.description: Budget for fees as a decimal string in the fee asset's units, or null when no estimate applies.

oneOf.description: Suggested next action for the refusal, or null when none is available.

fix.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

fromFinancialAccountId.description: Identifier of the selected funding account, or null when none is selected.

lpWhitelist.description:
`listed` when the LP's own whitelist read listed the source wallet for this asset, otherwise `unconfirmed`.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

obligationIds.description: Identifiers of the obligations this payment would meet in whole or in part.

The latest payment started for this transfer's obligation, as its native owners stand.
Its held amount is already excluded from `sendable`; it does not block a further part.

payment.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

amountBasis.description: Whether amounts are based on a locked statement or an upcoming estimate.

automaticSelectionAllowed.description: Whether this window is eligible for automatic selection of payments.

oneOf.description: Frequency of the window's schedule, or null when the schedule could not be read.

cadence.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

oneOf.description:
Where the window's amounts came from (`from`) and went (`to`): nettings, carried-forward
amounts and carry fees, each naming the other window, asset, exact amount and fee facts. Null
before the window's statement, or when its carries could not be read (`failedReads` names
`carries`).

carries.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

oneOf.description:
The granted client's statement figures and identity, only on a maker plan. No wallet or
funding-source detail is exposed. The statement's amounts retain their LP-relative meaning.

client.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

oneOf.description:
Each clock with how sure it is and what says so. Null when the window's schedule version
or selection could not be read; `failedReads` then names `schedule`.

clocks.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

completionAt.description: Scheduled settlement completion time, or null when no fixed time is specified.

oneOf.description: Progress from the window's matching evidence; null before the statement or when unreadable.

counterparty.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

cutoffAt.description: Trade cutoff time, or null when there is no separate cutoff.

group.description: Due-date grouping for this window in the plan.

legs.description:
Per asset and direction: owed, met, in flight, held, remaining and sendable. Null when the
window's amounts could not be read; `failedReads` then names `obligations`.

oneOf.description:
What the window's statement decided against the schedule's minimum settlement
(`belowMinimum`: the workspace's payments carry into a later window). Null before the
statement or when the schedule has no minimum.

minimumOutcome.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

owed.description: Settlement obligations payable by the requesting side.

payeeVenueAccountId.description:
The venue account a payment for this window pays: the window's own account, or, for an
account merged into another connection of the same venue account, the surviving account,
whose page lists this window too.

paymentDeadlineAt.description: Effective deadline to send payments, or null when there is no known clock deadline.

proposedTransfers.description: Proposed payments for this window's obligations, not transfer instructions or authorization.

scheduleId.description: Identifier of the schedule that produced this window.

snapshotAt.description: Scheduled time for the statement snapshot.

oneOf.description: Why the window's snapshot failed, with its named cause, when `status` is `snapshotFailed`.

snapshotFailure.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

statementVersion.description: Version of the locked statement, or null before one is available.

status.description:
Current settlement status for this window, including named snapshot or read failures.
`awaitingLpStatement`: the LP issues this window's statement and has not issued it yet, so
nothing is owed yet.

supersededBy.description:
The later window whose statement covers this one (it lists this window among its deferred
windows). Null when no later window covers it.

toReceive.description: Settlement obligations payable to the requesting side.

oneOf.description:
Whose move it is under the relationship's sending order. Nobody before the statement locks;
null when the terms, obligations or payment shares needed to decide could not be read.

turn.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

turnSince.description:
The statement clock for the first mover, or the other side's recorded arrival when answering.
Null when nobody needs to move or that historical time is not available.

venueAccountId.description: Identifier of the venue account this window settles.

venueId.description: Identifier of the venue where the account is held.

venueName.description: Display name of the venue where the account is held.

PlanWindowTurn.description:
Who needs to move on a locked window, relative to the requesting perspective.

PlatformStatus.description:
The workspace's platform status: onboarding, active, suspended or deactivated. lifecycle tells a KYB lapse apart from a suspension.

allOf.description:
Written as `quality`, never `firm`: a price binds no venue. Uses the
card's one firmness writer, so a row and a card never disagree on the shape.

oneOf.description: `levels` or `model`; `null` when the row holds no price.

basis.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

oneOf.description: Present whenever `levels` is: `incremental` or `allIn`.

ladderSemantics.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

levels.description: The venue's own levels in sell units, read as `ladderSemantics` says.

oneOf.description:
Where the price executes; `null` on a row with no cached corridor (a venue that
holds nothing for the pair).

location.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

oneOf.description: Why the row is not tradable; absent when it is.

notTradableReason.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

sizes.description: One entry per requested size, in request order; empty when the row holds no price.

spreadFromMidBps.description:
At the first size, against the Reference mid; `unavailable` when the mid cannot be
read, never 0.

tradable.description:
Whether an order can be placed against this row's prices: `true` when at least one size
carries a `priceId`. Tradable here: a venue that streams executable all-in prices to this
workspace's own connection, and an exchange order book priced net of this workspace's own
account fee (`netReceived` known). An order book is not firm: its order re-reads the book
and fills inside the order's limit or not at all. Every other venue is traded through a quote.

PriceRow.description: One venue's price for one location and variant pair.

PriceRowStatus.description:
A row's outcome:

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `priced` | a fresh cached price |
| `stale` | past `staleAfter`, or a private source still warming; any price kept |
| `unsupported` | `pairNotServed`: the venue holds nothing for the pair; `priceSourceNone`: it publishes no price (asked only on `POST /quotes`); `buyAmountUnsupported` |
| `belowMin` | the first size is under the source's minimum |
| `insufficientDepth` | the source cannot fill the first size |
| `needsWallet` | the venue prices only for a wallet |
| `restricted` | a gate keeps the desk price from this principal |
| `unavailable` | a read failed, or a fee could not be computed; `notYetPublished`: the venue publishes this pair and nothing is cached for it yet |

PublicOrderStatus.description:
Open public lifecycle vocabulary shared by both order kinds. States may be
skipped; act on `terminal`, not on a particular sequence.

An executed order reads `filled` while its settlement still moves and `settled`
once it has settled, or when nothing was left to settle. A fill paid from a
venue balance settles at once and reads `settled`. A fill on credit settles in
a later window: it reads `filled` with `terminal` false and `settlementStatus`
`awaitingWindow` until that window settles, then `settled` (`failed` if the
window ends unsettled). A credit fill with
no recorded settlement terms ends `filled` with `terminal` true. The order list
and the order read give the same `status` and `terminal`.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

QuoteSourceEntry.description:
One considered venue's outcome, tagged `status`. New statuses may be added; treat an unknown
one as a venue that gave no price:

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `asking` | in flight on the stream only: the auction is consulting this venue now; its final outcome replaces it under the same venue key, and none remains at `complete` |
| `answered` | the venue produced a quote |
| `needsWallet` | no wallet of `family` to ask with |
| `walletRefused` | the bound wallet is refused (`Revoked`, a confirmed sanctions hit) |
| `firmQuoteLimited` | a desk's firm-quote cap applies; `explanation` is product copy |
| `indicative` | the venue's price is shown without a firm-price ask; `quoteId` identifies the indicative card, whose `firmAsk` says whether the binding price comes on request or at execution |
| `priceOnRequest` | no venue price was requested; `quoteId` identifies the held estimate or stub to Requote |
| `askLimitReached` | the venue's ask limit is reached for now; `retryAfter` says when to ask again |
| `timedOut` | no answer inside the deadline |
| `refused` | the venue refused the live ask |
| `restricted` | a gate kept the venue from this principal |
| `unsupported` | the venue does not serve the pair |
| `filteredOut` | the request's own filters exclude it (never a coverage or chain gap) |
| `unavailable` | a read failed (`admissionUnavailable`, …) |

An unscreened default wallet is not a status: the quote carries `screening`. `venue`
is the venue block, its `id` the one quote legs and `/prices` rows carry. Durations
(`retryAfter`) are ISO 8601, counted from when the response was sent. Every entry
carries `asked`: whether this venue was consulted for this request (`consulted`: a live
ask, or a fresh read of its published book or live desk price within that source's
freshness window) or not (`notConsulted`). An estimate no venue gave (a model or reference
price) is not consulted, and an `answered` entry is always consulted. How a card's price
was obtained is its own price basis, never this field.

QuoteSourceFix.description:
The server-owned next step for a blocked source. It describes recovery, never grants authority.
Unknown causes carry `none`; unknown amounts, approvers and existing requests are never invented.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

amount.description: Known amount limit for the requote, as a decimal string; omitted when no limit was identified.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

QuoteSourceFixChangePair.description: The venue does not trade this pair: choose another pair, or ask other venues.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

QuoteSourceFixChangeSide.description:
The venue quotes only the other fixed amount for this pair: ask again fixing `side`
(`receiveExact`: the amount received; `payExact`: the amount paid).

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

side.description: Which side to fix in the new quote, the amount paid or the amount received.

QuoteSourceFixCreateOrganisationWallet.description:
Create an organisation wallet on `network`: the workspace has none there that the caller
can trade from, so the venue (a Basic on-chain account) has nothing to quote for. Treasury
creates it; the venue's own setup follows.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

network.description: CAIP-2 network the new organisation wallet needs to support.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

target.description: Venue to enable before asking for another quote.

who.description:
Who enables the venue: `place_order`, a member who can trade (a venue operator; a
member holding `manage_credentials` may also).

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

QuoteSourceFixGrantKeyOrganisationWallet.description:
Grant the calling API key the organisation wallet the venue would trade from, then ask
again: the key trades only the organisation wallets granted to it. `action` is the
`PUT` route that replaces the key's organisation wallets, so the caller sends the key's
current wallets (its `GET` on the same route) plus `walletId`. A member key is granted by
its own member; a service-account key by an Owner or a member who manages credentials.
`walletId` is absent when the refused wallet can't be named, never guessed.

action.description: Relative path of the operation for replacing the API key's allowed wallets.

credentialId.description: Identifier of the API key that needs access to the paying wallet.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

walletId.description: Identifier of the wallet to add to the key's allowed wallets, when known.

QuoteSourceFixLinkWallet.description:
Link a personal wallet that pays on `chain`: this card pays from a member's personal wallet,
which only Advanced (TetraFi's router) serves, and none is linked there.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

network.description: CAIP-2 network on which the personal wallet must be linked.

QuoteSourceFixManageVenueAccount.description:
Take `step` on the workspace's existing account at `target`: the venue is not asked until
a member with `who` takes it there.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

step.description: Action to take on the venue account before asking again.

target.description: Venue whose existing account needs attention.

who.description:
Who takes this action: `place_order`, a member who can trade (a venue operator; a
member holding `manage_credentials` may also).

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

QuoteSourceFixReduceAmount.description:
Within the account's credit limit but short of available credit: an order of at most
`maxAmount` `asset` (the debit asset; exact, rounded down) passes the same check.

asset.description: Asset debited for this trade.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

maxAmount.description: Maximum debit that passes the same credit check, as a decimal string in `asset` units.

QuoteSourceFixRefreshCredit.description:
The account's credit figures could not be read (or are too old) to decide this trade:
ask the quote again to read them afresh. `lastGoodReadAt` is the last good read, if any.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

lastGoodReadAt.description: When credit was last read successfully, omitted when no successful read is known.

QuoteSourceFixRequestAgain.description:
Ask the venue again, unchanged: the cause was transient (its reason is retryable in the
published catalogue), and nothing was traded.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

QuoteSourceFixRequestPermission.description:
Ask for the permission or wallet right `target`. For a member session it is offered only
when the permission-request owner would open (or already holds) a request on it; a target
it refuses by name (`blocked`, `not_applicable`, ...) reads `none`. When that read fails,
the step is offered unchanged.

action.description: Relative path for requesting the permission, when available.

existingRequest.description:
The calling member's own pending request for this same target (the target key
the create route deduplicates on, so a request made from another venue's card
counts), read once per auction: the member already asked, so a client shows that
instead of offering a second request. Absent when there is none, when the read
failed or timed out (never a guessed value), and always for API keys and
automation principals: only a member session's quotes carry it.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

target.description: Permission or wallet right to request.

QuoteSourceFixReviewPositions.description:
Already over the account's credit limit: no smaller amount passes, only a trade that
reduces what the account owes. Review the venue account's positions.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

venueAccountId.description: Identifier of the venue account whose positions need review.

QuoteSourceFixReviewSettlementSchedule.description:
A credit trade settles in the venue account's settlement window, and that account's
schedule cannot produce one yet (a term the LP has not confirmed). Review the account's
settlement schedule and its pending request, where the LP's answer is recorded.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

venueAccountId.description: Identifier of the venue account whose settlement schedule needs review.

QuoteSourceFixSetUpEmbeddedWallets.description:
Set up wallet infrastructure (Integrations › Wallet infrastructure): the workspace's
embedded wallets are not set up or are turned off, so no trading grant can be prepared
on a member's own embedded wallet until they are. An organisation wallet held by
TetraFi's platform provider needs no such setup for its trading grant.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

QuoteSourceFixSetUpSigningGrant.description:
Set up a signing grant for `venueId` on the paying wallet (Treasury › the wallet › Signing):
the wallet has no active grant for this venue, so it was not asked. One of the wallet's
owners sets it up; no permission request reaches a grant. `walletId` is absent when the
source can't name the paying wallet, never guessed.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

venueId.description: Identifier of the venue the new signing grant must cover.

walletId.description: Identifier of the paying wallet that needs a signing grant, when known.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

QuoteSourceFixTopUp.description:
Fund `target`. `amount` is the measured shortfall; it is absent when the shortfall is
unknown (a venue that declined for insufficient balance does not say by how much), and the
step is offered all the same.

amount.description: Measured shortfall as a decimal string, omitted when the amount is unknown.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

target.description: Wallet or venue account that needs more funds.

kind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

until.description: Earliest time to ask for another quote after the current limit.

QuoteTradingSourceRefusal.description: Why a priced card has no executable source, with the native in-page recovery action.

code.description: Machine-readable code explaining why the trading source cannot be used.

creditRefusal.description: The credit owner's exact refusal, including its cause and recovery action.

detail.description: Human-readable recovery, including key re-issuance or a wallet grant.

fix.description: Recovery action, if one is available for the refusal.

venueId.description: Identifier of the venue whose trading source was refused.

QuoteVenue.description:
The venue block. A protocol version is part of the venue's identity. `id` is
the registry's venue id, the same one `/prices` rows and `sources[]` carry.

id.description: Identifier of the pricing source, shared with price rows and quote-source outcomes.

integrationMode.description:
The integration mode this venue was reached through:
Basic (`basic`) or Advanced (`advanced`), the committed
`IntegrationMode` wire values. Absent where no mode applies (a price row). Staged: read
first, then written, so a venue reached in both modes keeps two outcomes.

logoUrl.description:
The venue's logo: always sent; the logo the venue's LP uploaded
to its workspace (`/api/v1/brand/logos/<sha256>.webp`), else `null`, when the UI
shows its preset or generated mark. Never synthesised from the venue id or name.

modality.description: Type of venue used to price or execute this quote.

name.description: Display name of the pricing source.

protocolVersion.description: Version of the venue protocol used, or `null` when none is specified.

venueId.description:
The catalogue Venue, distinct from this route's registry/execution id.
Absent for routes no Venue declares (DEX pools and registered solvers).

venueName.description: The catalogue Venue's display name, present exactly when `venue_id` is present.

QuoteWalletSelection.description: One chain's selected wallet and the venue account whose selection it is.

connectionId.description: Identifier of the venue account connection used to select the wallet.

displacedPreference.description: A known eligible preference that this account did not link. Display only.

reason.description: Whether the wallet was explicitly chosen, preferred, or selected as the account default.

venueId.description: Identifier of the venue associated with the connection.

venueName.description: Display name of the venue associated with the connection.

walletId.description: Identifier of the wallet selected on this network.

QuoteWalletSelectionReason.description:
The origin of a bound Basic wallet, not a signing or permission grant.

for delayed timing only, how it settles: its window, or any time.

burstSize.description: Configured burst allowance for requests before the rate limit needs to replenish.

ownerCode.description: Original error code reported for the failed read, when available.

Whether the quote can be ordered now. Unknown is `unavailable`,
never a value.

RequoteRequest.description:
Asks the venue of an earlier quote again. Only these fields.

Requote is explicit firm intent, including for a quote originally requested as
`indicative`: every eligible desk is firm-asked under the same authority and limits.
It does not inherit the origin's firmness; non-desk planning is unchanged.

Only that quote's venue (every venue of a multi-leg route) is asked, for the same pair, amount and side,
and the answer is one new held quote with `requoteOf`; the original stays orderable until its own expiry.
A venue's indicative card gets its firm quote this way (every such venue, including one whose
firm quote lives 5 s or less and whose card offers Execute within your limit, `next: order`), like naming
the venue in `filters.venues.include`, under the same desk ask limits. Refusals, each by name: 404
`QUOTE_NOT_FOUND` (unknown or another principal's), 410 `QUOTE_EXPIRED` (over 10 minutes past expiry),
400 `CORRIDOR_NOT_OFFERED`, 403 `SOURCE_NOT_OWNED`,
409 `PERSONAL_TARGET_NOT_ALLOWED` (an API key naming a personal wallet), 400 `WALLET_NOT_ON_NETWORK`,
403 `ACCOUNT_NOT_AVAILABLE`, 403 `VENUE_NOT_AVAILABLE_TO_CREDENTIAL`, 409 `REQUOTE_REFUSED` (the venue's
reason in `message`, its token in `details.reason`), 409 `REQUOTE_NEEDS_WALLET`, 504 `REQUOTE_TIMED_OUT`,
429 `RATE_LIMITED` / `VENUE_FIRM_QUOTE_LIMITED` / `BUDGET_EXHAUSTED` with `Retry-After`.

A venue-account or funding-account choice replaces the source selection. Receiving wallets
retained from the quote remain delivery choices, not additional trading-wallet authority.

SourceSelection.description:
An explicit request choice. A trading wallet is named by its financial-account id or by its
own address on that network; an account is named by its financial-account id.

fundingAccountId.description: Financial account identifier of the linked account selected to provide funds, if specified.

tradingWallets.description:
The paying wallet per network (CAIP-2), each `{wallet, signer?}`: `wallet` is a
financial-account id or the wallet's own address, and `signer` says who signs it.

propertyNames.description:
A CAIP-2 chain id (`eip155:8453`, `solana:<genesis>`, `tron:shasta`), syntax-checked:
a namespace of 3 to 8 lowercase letters, digits or `-`, and a reference of 1 to 32
letters, digits, `-` or `_`. Compared exactly, as CAIP-2 references are case-sensitive.

venueAccountId.description: Financial account identifier of the selected venue account, if specified.

SourceSigner.description:
The request's explicit signer choice for one named wallet. `you`: the client signs a wallet
TetraFi could otherwise sign (a custody wallet the client signs through its own custodian).
`tetrafi`: TetraFi signs under the wallet's signing grant, and a wallet only the client can
sign is refused rather than quoted client-signed. Absent: who signs follows from the wallet.

agreeLpFigures.description: Whether the viewer may agree to the latest recorded provider figures before agreement.

pay.description: Availability of direct wallet payment from this review.

recordKeepAnswer.description: Whether the viewer may record the provider's answer to a pending keep request.

availablePositive.description: Uncommitted positive: snapshot positive less earlier open LP deliveries.

rows.description: Take and keep choices by statement asset.

savedBy.description: Identifier of the member who saved the choices, or null when choices use the default.

source.description:
`default` (take every positive) until a member saves, then `saved`.

asset.description: Asset in which all amounts for this row are expressed.

availableToTake.description: Positive position available to take, as a decimal string in `asset` units.

carriedForwardObligationIds.description: Identifiers of earlier obligations carried forward into this window.

chosenToTakePositive.description: Portion of the positive position selected for withdrawal, as a decimal string in `asset` units.

newOwedToWorkspace.description: Newly owed delivery to the workspace, as a decimal string in `asset` units.

payAmount.description: Amount payable by the workspace for this window, as a decimal string in `asset` units.

position.description: Net venue position at the snapshot, as a signed decimal string in `asset` units.

StatementSource.description:
Who issues the window's statement. `indicative`: TetraFi builds it at the snapshot and the
workspace compares it with the LP's email. `lpIssued`: the LP's own statement is authoritative,
and the window becomes payable only once a member agrees the LP's recorded figures.

StatementSourceTerm.description:
A statement source is always a confirmed term. A schedule published before the term existed
reads as `indicative`, which is how those windows always behaved.

Unavailable. `notReported` only means the provider does not report credit; it never
erases an agreed facility or local commitments.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

observedAt.description: When the ledger was read without a reported credit figure.

source.description: Source that was read without reporting credit.

status.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

asset.description: The asset the credit line is in.

available.description: Negative when usage exceeds the limit.

creditPosition.description: The account's signed position in the credit currency, when it holds one.

oneOf.description: The account terms' exposure rule; absent when the terms could not be read.

exposureRule.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

limit.description: Credit limit reported by the venue, as a decimal string in the credit asset's units.

limitSource.description: Where the meter's limit comes from: the provider's own line.

observedAt.description: When the credit figures were observed.

source.description: Source of the reported credit figures.

status.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

used.description: Credit used according to the venue, as a decimal string in the credit asset's units.

utilizationPct.description: used / limit in percent; absent at a zero limit.

cause.description: More specific cause of the failed or missing observation.

component.description: Part of the account read affected by the error.

error.description: Machine-readable error code for the unavailable credit observation.

lastGoodReadAt.description: When the last successful read was made, if known; not the time of this failure.

status.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

oneOf.description: Which occurrence of a repeated local time to use, or null when no rule is specified.

ambiguous.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

nonexistent.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

TradeActionRequired.description: An action a person must take before the order can progress.

code.description:
Stable machine code: `AWAITING_TAKER_SIGNATURE`, `PRICE_MOVED`, `NEXT_LEG_DID_NOT_RUN`, `FINISH_TRADE`,
`STOPPED` or `SUPPORT_REVIEW`.

keyId.description: Identifier of the API key that placed the trade, not the key itself.

name.description: Display name recorded for the API key, or null if unknown.

not.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Negated field-presence predicates for an optional flattened object, not wire variants.

allOf.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Optional flattened object: validates either the full block or absence of every block field; no separate wire value to tag.

TradeDetail.description: One trade, read through the same projection as the list.

oneOf.description: API key attribution for the order, or `null` when unavailable or not applicable.

apiKey.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

oneOf.description: Channel where the order originated, or `null` when not recorded.

channel.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

deferredSettlement.description: Recorded deferred settlement details, omitted when none are available.

deliveredBuy.description:
The buy amount actually delivered: the figure `slippage_bps` and its
provenance are derived from, so an operator reading "12 bps, measured" can
see what landed. Absent when nothing was captured (unsettled, or a row
written before the capture existed).

deliveredBuyProvenance.description:
Provenance of the delivered buy amount behind `slippage_bps`: `"measured"`
when read back from settlement evidence, `"quoted"` when the quote-time
value was carried forward unmeasured (slippage then reads 0 by
construction). Absent for orders with no delivered capture and rows
predating the capture.

executionPrice.description: Display price with its asset units and the source of the value.

fillTimeSeconds.description:
Seconds from order creation to recorded fill (millisecond precision), omitted when the
duration is not established.

lifecycleStatus.description: Current trade progress, including lifecycle steps and whether they are complete.

orderId.description: Identifier of the order represented by this trade record.

route.description: Display details for the sell and buy assets and amounts.

routingPath.description: Structured direct or broker routing information, omitted when not recorded.

routingPathLabel.description: Human-readable label for the route by which this trade reached its counterparty.

slippageBps.description: Recorded difference from expected delivery in basis points, omitted when no value was recorded.

slippageToleranceBps.description: The accepted tolerance, in integer basis points (one basis point is 0.01%).

status.description: The order's status, the same value its order read answers.

valueUsd.description:
USD value of the trade (its input notional), as a decimal string. Absent when the order
recorded no USD notional; never 0 for an unknown amount.

fee.description: The fee in the network's own coin (decimal string and its registry symbol), when recorded.

feeKind.description: Category of fee, such as gas or a liquidity provider spread.

feePayer.description: Party that bore the fee, such as the taker or solver.

feeUsd.description: USD value of the fee as a decimal string, when priced.

gasPrice.description:
The price paid per gas unit, in the network's own coin (decimal string and its registry
symbol), when recorded.

gasUsed.description: Gas consumed in gas units, when recorded.

networkRef.description: The fee row's recorded network spelling.

recordedAt.description: When the fee line was recorded.

sequenceNumber.description: Sequence used to order fee lines for this trade.

txHash.description: Transaction hash associated with the fee, when recorded.

txType.description: Type of transaction or trade activity associated with this fee.

TradeFillOutcome.description: Execution outcome of a placed trade, independent of its settlement lifecycle.

TradeKind.description:
The kinds the one trade history lists.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeKindFilter.description: Explicit population selection, not an unsupported-filter exclusion.

TradeLeg.description:
One leg of a trade in the request's own vocabulary: the Asset sold or bought, its chain
when the leg is on-chain, and an amount whose meaning the field naming the leg states.

amount.description: Quantity sold or bought on this leg, as a decimal string in `asset` units.

asset.description: Asset sold or bought on this leg.

network.description: The leg's CAIP-2 network; absent for a leg held on a venue account (off-chain).

TradeLegConfirmAgainReason.description:
Why a deposit-first pay-in needs a new consent: the fresh
price missed the consented minimum receipt, or the bound lapsed before the
deposit was credited.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLegDestination.description:
Where a payout leg delivers, by reference only: never bank or chain
coordinates.

approvalId.description: The venue destination approval a wallet delivery goes through.

ref.description: The wallet id or the Treasury Destination id.

TradeLegDestinationKind.description:
What a payout leg delivers to, in the binding's endpoint vocabulary.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLegDirection.description:
Whether the leg brings money to the LP account before the trade, or takes
the trade's output away from it.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLegExpectedArrivalSource.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

oneOf.description: Bank statement arrival or return step for a sent payout, or null when no step applies.

bankStep.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

boundLapsesAt.description: Deposit-first consent's last authorized instant, in the rail's business time.

confirmAgainReason.description: Reason fresh trade confirmation is required, or null when no reason is recorded.

consentedPayoutFee.description: The exact fee bound recorded by Confirm, derived from immutable consent.

creditedAmount.description: The venue-credited amount that funded this pay-in, exact decimal.

currentPayoutFee.description: The qualified estimate observed when dispatch stopped for a fee rise.

declaredPayoutFee.description: Current qualified withdrawal estimate, returned by prepare in the receipt asset.

destination.description: Recorded destination for the leg, or null when none applies.

direction.description: Whether this leg is a pay-in or payout.

expectedArrivalAt.description: Estimated time funds should reach their destination, or null when no estimate is known.

expectedArrivalSource.description: Whether the arrival estimate came from the provider or default terms, or null when unknown.

finality.description: Whether a settled payout can still be returned. Absent for an unsettled leg or a settled leg without a provider return watch.

fundingDeadlineAt.description: Deadline for funding the pay-in, or null when no funding deadline applies.

fundingModel.description: Funding model of the bank leg, or null when no model was recorded.

fundsReceivedAt.description: The venue's own credit time of that amount.

holidaysApplied.description: Whether the timing calculation applied holidays, or null when the calculation was not recorded.

outcomeCode.description: Machine-readable outcome reason, or null when no reason was recorded.

overdueAt.description: Scheduled time after which an unresolved leg becomes overdue, or null when not established.

overdueSince.description: Time the leg crossed its overdue threshold, or null if no overdue transition was recorded.

oneOf.description: Own-bank account verification for this leg, or null when it is not projected.

ownBankVerification.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

payoutApproval.description: Treasury approval requirements for the payout, or null when no approval is projected.

payoutBreakdown.description: Withdrawal, fee and expected receipt bounds for the payout, or null when unavailable or inapplicable.

payoutBreakdownUnavailableReason.description: Unavailable fee information never means zero fee.

payoutHeldReason.description: The funding-stage refusal code holding this planned payout: FUNDING_STAGE_DISABLED, EXECUTION_STOPPED, VENUE_PAYOUT_CAP_EXCEEDED, VENUE_DAILY_CAP_EXCEEDED or EXECUTION_NOTIONAL_UNVALUED. The leg stays planned and is retried; absent when not held.

quotedExpectedArrivalAt.description: The confirmed quote's estimate for this exact bank rail and option.

rail.description: Specific bank rail assigned to this leg, or null when not applicable or unknown.

railOption.description: Selected speed option for the bank rail, or null when no option is recorded.

oneOf.description: A genuine bank rail reference or named not-reported state; absent on non-bank-payout legs.

railReference.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

oneOf.description: The receiving workspace's assertion, never settlement or independent verification.

recipientConfirmation.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

returnWindowEndsAt.description: For a returnable leg whose rail documents a return window, midnight after its last day in the rail's clearing time zone. Absent when no window is documented; never estimated.

returnedAfterSettlement.description: A settled payout later returned; its row stays immutable.

oneOf.description: Account or provider balance to which funds returned, or null when no return is reported.

returnedTo.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

reviewAt.description: Time scheduled for manual review if still unresolved, or null if none is scheduled.

reviewEnteredAt.description: Time the leg entered manual review, or null when not recorded.

reviewItemId.description: Identifier of the manual review item, or null when no item was recorded.

oneOf.description: Reason the leg entered manual review, or null when none was recorded.

reviewReason.x-undiscriminated-union-reason: Nullable value: JSON null has no properties and cannot carry a discriminator.

settlementRail.description: Whether the leg settles on a bank rail or on-chain.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this payment leg.

submittedAt.description: Time the leg's submission was recorded, or null before it is known.

tradeLegId.description: Identifier of this payment leg. Named `tradeLegId` because `legId` always names a route leg.

transactionHash.description: Transaction hash of the wallet payout, or null when none has been recorded.

venueReportedCredited.description: Only an explicit receiving-bank credit report from the venue; withdrawal completion is not credit.

venueWithdrawalId.description: A wallet payout's native withdrawal id, never a bank arrival assertion.

venueWithdrawalStatus.description: The venue's withdrawal observation, never proof of bank arrival.

TradeLegFinality.description:
A settled payout's finality, from its return watch and any recorded payout-return review.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLegOutcomeCode.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLegPayoutApproval.description:
Treasury's existing Run approval for a bank payout. No funds are reserved
while this approval is pending; release rechecks balances and terms.

approvalRequestId.description: Identifier of the approval request, or null before one has been created.

approvalsRequired.description: Number of approvals required by the payout policy.

approverGroup.description: Identifier of the required approver group, or null when no group is specified.

approverGroupName.description: Display name of the required approver group, or null when no group is specified.

approverNames.description: Display names of eligible approvers, using a user identifier where no name is available.

runId.description: Identifier of the Treasury run, or null before one has been created.

TradeLegPayoutBreakdown.description: What a payout takes from the venue account, its fee and what arrives, as exact decimals in the leg's asset. The venue sends gross minus fee. With on-top charging the account loses gross and the bank receives the amount sent; with deducted charging the bank receives one fee less; when unverified, withdrawn is the maximum debit and receivedMin to receivedMax bounds the receipt.

basis.description: The withdrawal record these amounts come from.

charging.description:
How the venue charges a bank payout's fee, as its rail declares it
(`deducted`, `on_top`, `unverified`). Absent on a wallet payout, whose fee
is Confirm's bound rather than a declared rail fee.

fee.description:
The most fee: a bank payout's declared payout fee (frozen by the
withdrawal review once there is one), else Confirm's fee bound.

withdrawn.description: The most leaving the venue account: the confirmed trade's output.

TradeLegPayoutBreakdownBasis.description:
Which record a payout breakdown comes from.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLegRail.description:
How the leg settles: a bank rail or a chain transfer.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLegReturnedAfterSettlement.description:
A return the provider reported after the payout
leg settled, read from its entry-coupled PayoutReturned review item.

detectedAt.description: When TetraFi's own status read first saw the return.

reviewItemId.description: The PayoutReturned review item support works the return from.

TradeLegReturnedTo.description:
Where a returned leg's funds remain, according to its dispatch backend.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLegReviewReason.description:
The reason a leg requires review.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLegState.description:
The leg's state. The last five are terminal.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLifecycleBucket.description:
The history bucket chosen by the server's lifecycle projection.

New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

TradeLifecycleFlowKind.description: New values may be added; treat unknown values as other.

bucket.description:
Which history bucket this lifecycle belongs to: decided by the same arm that
chose `primary`, so a filter on it can never disagree with the label.

execution.description: Execution step, or null when no separate execution step is reported.

flowKind.description: Lifecycle flow used to interpret the trade's stages, such as immediate or deferred settlement.

primary.description: Overall step to display for the trade.

settlement.description: Settlement step, or null when no separate settlement step is reported.

terminal.description: Whether the projected lifecycle has reached a terminal outcome.

withdrawal.description: Withdrawal step, or null when no separate withdrawal step is reported.

TradeLifecycleStep.description:
A compact backend-owned display status for personal trade/order surfaces.

`orders.settlement_status` remains a coarse analytics bucket; UI should use
this shape for user-facing execution/settlement state.

key.description: Machine-readable identifier for this lifecycle step.

label.description: Human-readable label for this lifecycle step.

tone.description: Display emphasis for this step, distinguishing progress, success, waiting and failure.

TradeList.description: One page of the trade history.

With `include`: each relation's object per listed trade, keyed by `tradeId`, as that
relation's own GET answers this caller, or null with its refusal.
